product.en: Language Book: a cross-language comparable semantic database
product.zh-Hans: Language Book：跨语言可比较语义数据库

publication_boundary.en: An entry may be published; a hypothesis must be graded; literature may explore freely; evidence must be evaluated independently.
publication_boundary.zh-Hans: 词条可以发表，假说必须标级，文学可以自由展开，证据必须独立核验。

data_separation.en: One English word → one primary Chinese mapping → separate historical etymology → separate sound-semantic hypothesis → separate experimental validation.
data_separation.zh-Hans: 一个英语词 → 一个主要汉语 Mapping → 独立历史词源 → 独立声音假说 → 独立实验验证。

present_day_vs_diachronic.en: Present-day Mapping ≠ Diachronic Mapping. Modern standard semantic mapping is separate from the featured candidate; historical-unit comparisons have separate fields, assessments and historical-relation boundaries. Diachronic Stage Mapping Principle: modern forms, historical forms/roots and earlier semantic stages may receive separate Chinese mappings when form, meaning or semantic operation changes materially; not one character per language. Each stage records its own evidence, status and confidence. Mapping pending is valid; Chinese Historical Relation stays Not claimed.
present_day_vs_diachronic.zh-Hans: 现代词义映射 ≠ 历时语义映射。现代标准语义映射与特色候选分开；历史单位比较使用独立字段、评分及历史关系边界。历时阶段映射原则：现代形式、历史形式／词根及早期语义阶段，仅在形式、意义或语义操作发生实质变化时分别映射；不机械要求每语言一汉字。每阶段单列证据、状态、置信度；允许 Mapping pending，汉语历史关系仍为 Not claimed。

featured_mapping_selection.en: Featured Mapping is selected per entry and may differ from Standard Translation; selection must state whether its strength is phonetic, semantic, cognitive, dialectal, or cultural.
featured_mapping_selection.zh-Hans: Featured Mapping 按每个词具体选择，可以不同于标准翻译；须注明优势属于语音、语义、认知、方言或文化，并分别标明证据类型和置信度。

non_cognacy_position.en: The database compares languages; it is not evidence that all languages share one historical origin.
non_cognacy_position.zh-Hans: 本数据库用于跨语言比较，不是“所有语言历史同源”的证明。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Lexical equivalent

rationale.en: Calibration case: ordinary lexical equivalence (sky → 天空), the sky ↔ 盖 candidate, independent word histories, the ABOVE → COVER schema and literary interpretation remain separate.
rationale.zh-Hans: Mapping 校准案例：普通词义对应（sky → 天空）、sky ↔ 盖候选、各自词史、ABOVE → COVER 图式与文学解释保持分离。

summary.en: English sky, French ciel and Chinese 天/盖 each have independently documented histories; none establishes an English–Chinese cognate relation.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 sky、法语 ciel 与汉语“天／盖”各有独立可考的历史；这些材料不能建立英汉同源关系。

claim.en: Middle English sky continues Old Norse ský ‘cloud’; the English sense expanded to the visible upper region.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 sky 承自古诺尔斯语 ský“云”，英语词义后来扩展至可见的上方空间。

claim.en: French ciel continues Latin caelum, ‘celestial vault / heaven.’
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 ciel 承自拉丁语 caelum“天穹／天界”。

claim.en: Early forms of 天 emphasize a person's head or highest point; the graph subsequently denotes the sky.
claim.zh-Hans: “天”的早期字形突出人首或最高处，后来用于表示天空。

summary.en: sky /skaɪ/ ↔ 盖 gài /kaɪ˥˩/ is a candidate velar and rhyme resemblance associated with the cognitive schema ABOVE → COVER.
summary.zh-Hans: sky /skaɪ/ ↔ 盖 gài /kaɪ˥˩/ 是候选软腭音与韵部近似观察，并与 ABOVE → COVER 认知图式相连。

summary.en: Recorded semantic structure: ABOVE → COVER.
summary.zh-Hans: 已记录语义结构：ABOVE → COVER。

summary.en: Author hypotheses remain independently graded and testable; they are not historical proof.
summary.zh-Hans: 作者假说保持独立分级与可检验性，不作为历史证明。

claim.en: sky ↔ 盖 as a phonetic-semantic and cognitive candidate
claim.zh-Hans: sky ↔ 盖：语音—语义与认知候选映射

claim.en: sky /skaɪ/ ↔ 盖 gài /kaɪ˥˩/ is a candidate velar and rhyme resemblance associated with the cognitive schema ABOVE → COVER.

limitations.en: Modern-form resemblance is not a regular sound correspondence or proof of cognacy.
limitations.zh-Hans: 现代词形近似不是规律音变，也不证明同源。

claim.zh-Hans: sky ↔ 盖：语音—语义与认知候选映射

testability.en: See the linked record for testability limits.
testability.zh-Hans: 可检验性边界见关联记录。

claim.en: The sixty-four hexagrams may be studied as another kind of writing; the author proposes Qian as their originating structure.
claim.zh-Hans: 六十四卦图可以作为我们的另一种文字来研究；作者提出“所有卦象都是从乾卦而来”。

counterexamples: This is not presented as a settled historical or Yijing conclusion
The combinatorial system also requires yin lines and includes Kun ☷ as a basic contrast

testability.en: Define ‘originating structure’ and compare it with received-text, excavated-text and combinatorial accounts of the hexagram system.
testability.zh-Hans: 须先定义“从乾卦而来”的结构含义，再与传世文献、出土材料及卦象组合方式比较。

proposition.en: The blue sky is the cover above us, changing through day and night, sun and moon, and the turning seasons.
proposition.zh-Hans: 蓝天是覆盖我们的被盖，昼日夜月，四季变换。

text.en: Standing on a mountain and looking up at the sky, I watch the white clouds wandering overhead. At moments the earth itself seems to move, while the houses rise and fall like sampans and ocean liners. Across oceans and great rivers, wherever we are able to sail, we may never travel over every part of Mother Earth. Even in passing, however, we may glimpse her skin and the places where her bones lie exposed—the mountains, ridges and valleys. The blue sky is the cover above us, changing through day and night, sun and moon, and the turning seasons.
text.zh-Hans: 站在山上向天空仰望，覺得天上的白雲在遊走，偶爾也會覺得地在走，房屋似此起彼伏的舢板與郵輪。在海洋、大河，在我們能夠航行的地方，我們雖未遊走在這大地母親的每一處，哪怕只是走馬觀花，也可以看看地母的每處肌膚、每處骨骼外露之處——那是山脈與丘壑。那藍天是我們的被蓋，晝日夜月，四季變換。

evidence_boundary.en: Literature may explore freely, but it is not historical evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 文学可以自由展开，但不属于历史证据。

featured_mapping.display_label: Featured phonetic-semantic candidate · 特色音义候选

boundary.en: 盖 is displayed first as the author's concise sound–meaning and cover-schema candidate. The standard translation remains 天空; modern resemblance does not establish cognacy.
boundary.zh-Hans: 先展示“盖”gài，作为作者提出的简洁音义与覆盖图式候选；通用翻译仍是“天空”，现代读音近似不证明同源。

source.author: Jinkai Liu
source.normalization: Traditional characters normalized where appropriate; pinyin and parts of speech normalized; English recast as a literary translation.
source.raw_note: 英语：sky n. 天；汉语：盖【gai】n.。六十四卦图是我们的另一种文字。所有卦象都是从乾卦而来。附乾卦原文、坤卦标题、天字字源说明、盖天说、《敕勒歌》，以及站在山上仰望白云、房屋如舢板与邮轮、大地母亲的肌肤与骨骼、蓝天是被盖的文学段落。原稿另将卫星、电离层和平流层并置为所仰望的盖天结构；编辑版将古代模型、现代大气层与地球外部空间分开说明。

gloss.en: The totality of space, time, matter and energy; also a complete conceptual world.
gloss.zh-Hans: 空间、时间、物质与能量的整体；也可指完整的概念世界。

meaning.en: The totality of space, time, matter and energy; also a complete conceptual world.
meaning.zh-Hans: 空间、时间、物质与能量的整体；也可指完整的概念世界。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Standard lexical translation

rationale.en: Translation is kept as the lexical baseline. Language Book mapping begins with the independently evidenced semantic operations inside Latin universus and compares Chinese candidates without claiming cognacy.
rationale.zh-Hans: 翻译仅作为词义底座；Language Book Mapping 从拉丁语 universus 内部有独立证据的语义操作出发，再比较汉语候选，不主张同源。

summary.en: Latin universus is historically analyzed as unus + versus (the participial form of vertere): one + turned, hence all together or whole. Chinese character histories are evaluated separately.
summary.zh-Hans: 拉丁语 universus 的标准历史分析为 unus + versus（vertere 的分词形式）：一＋转成，继而表示共同整体；汉字词史另行评估。

claim.en: universus: unus + versus / verto, ‘turned into one; combined into one whole.’
claim.zh-Hans: universus：unus＋versus／verto，即“转成一个、合为整体”。

claim.en: 轉 is glossed as 運也 in Shuowen; later lexicographic material records motion and rotation senses.
claim.zh-Hans: 《说文》释“轉”为“運也”；后世字书记录移动、旋转义。

claim.en: 斡 has an independently attested turn/rotate sense: ‘斡，轉也.’
claim.zh-Hans: “斡”有独立可证的旋转义：“斡，轉也”。

claim.en: 渦 is attested as 回川 with the gloss 旋流, supporting eddy/whirlpool rather than a cross-language origin claim.
claim.zh-Hans: “渦”见“回川”并注“旋流”，支持旋流／漩涡义，不支持跨语言同源。

claim.en: Huainanzi distinguishes 宙 as past-to-present time and 宇 as the four directions plus above and below.
claim.zh-Hans: 《淮南子》以“宙”指古往今来的时间，以“宇”指四方上下的空间。

summary.en: Modern Mandarin wò/wō forms are recorded as a testable sound–meaning cluster. Shared modern syllables do not establish common Chinese ancestry or relation to Latin VERS/VERT.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代普通话 wò／wō 形式作为可检验音义簇记录；现代音节相同既不证明汉字彼此同源，也不证明它们与拉丁 VERS／VERT 同源。

claim.en: Modern 斡 wò, 涡 wō, 窝 wō and 蜗 wō may be compared around TURN / CURVE / ROTATION, with separate lexical evidence for every character.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代“斡 wò、涡 wō、窝 wō、蜗 wō”可围绕 TURN／CURVE／ROTATION 比较，但每个字须各用独立词义证据。

summary.en: The comparison models two independently evidenced constructions—ONE + TURNED → WHOLE and SPACE + TIME → COSMOS—then marks ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE as a cognitive-geometric extension.
summary.zh-Hans: 比较并列两条独立有据的构词结构——ONE＋TURNED→WHOLE 与 SPACE＋TIME→COSMOS；ROTATION→VORTEX／CURL／ENCLOSURE 另标为认知—几何延伸。

claim.en: Abstract → Motion → Geometry → Symbol: TURN → ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE.
claim.zh-Hans: 抽象→动作→几何→符号：TURN→ROTATION→VORTEX／CURL／ENCLOSURE。

summary.en: Cognitive Trace, the author’s spiral-motion proposal, and Cosmic Motion Encoding are explicitly speculative/testable. Etymology does not establish a scientific model of the universe.
summary.zh-Hans: 语言认知痕迹、作者螺旋运动设想与宇宙运动编码均明确标为推测性／可检验；词源不能建立宇宙的科学模型。

claim.en: Language may preserve traces of how earlier human communities perceived, categorized, and modeled the world.
claim.zh-Hans: 语言可能保存早期人类群体感知、分类和构造世界模型的痕迹。

claim.en: Perhaps ancient people recognized rotational or spiral motion in the universe and preserved that cognition in structures such as universe.
claim.zh-Hans: 也许古人已经认识到宇宙具有旋转或螺旋式运动，并将这种认知保留在 universe 一类语言结构之中。

claim.en: Terms for cosmic totality may recruit ONE / TURN / CYCLE / ENCLOSE / SPACE / TIME more often than suitable controls across languages and cultures.
claim.zh-Hans: 跨语言／文化的宇宙整体词汇，是否比适当对照更频繁调用 ONE／TURN／CYCLE／ENCLOSE／SPACE／TIME。

claim.en: Modern Mandarin: 斡 wò, 涡 wō, 窝 wō, 蜗 wō. Their nearby modern forms motivate a cluster test only.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代普通话：斡 wò、涡 wō、窝 wō、蜗 wō；相近的现代读音只用于提出聚类检验。

limitations.en: No historical sound correspondence, shared Chinese etymon or Latin–Chinese cognacy is claimed. Historical pronunciations are omitted here unless tied to a named reconstruction or lexicographic source.
limitations.zh-Hans: 不主张规律历史音变、汉字共同语源或拉丁—汉语同源；未能逐项绑定具名重构或字书来源的历史音不写入。

semantic_structure.relation: ONE + TURNED → WHOLE | TURN → ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE | SPACE + TIME → COSMOS

claim.en: Modern wò/wō forms may show a testable concentration around TURN / CURVE / ROTATION.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代 wò／wō 形式可能在 TURN／CURVE／ROTATION 周围形成可检验聚集。

counterexamples: Modern homophony does not establish shared origin
窝 is primarily enclosure/bending
蜗 is primarily an animal name

testability.en: Build a pre-registered Mandarin lexical sample with frequency-matched syllable controls and independent semantic coding.
testability.zh-Hans: 建立预注册的普通话词汇样本，以频率匹配音节作对照，并进行独立语义编码。

claim.en: Language may preserve traces of how earlier human communities perceived, categorized, and modeled the world.
claim.zh-Hans: 语言可能保存早期人类群体感知、分类和构造世界模型的痕迹。

counterexamples: Lexicalization can be opaque to later speakers
Parallel metaphors need not reflect the same historical cognition

testability.en: Compare independently coded historical lexical constructions across unrelated language families and time periods.
testability.zh-Hans: 跨无亲缘语系与历史时期，对历史构词结构进行独立编码比较。

claim.en: Perhaps ancient people recognized rotational or spiral motion in the universe and preserved that cognition in structures such as universe.
claim.zh-Hans: 也许古人已经认识到宇宙具有旋转或螺旋式运动，并将这种认知保留在 universe 一类语言结构之中。

supporting_cases: TURN is historically present in the Latin formation
counterexamples: Historical evidence: Unestablished
Scientific claim: not established by etymology
TURN → spiral cosmos is an additional inference

testability.en: Require independent historical texts showing a cosmic rotation model linked to the lexical choice; etymology alone is insufficient.
testability.zh-Hans: 必须找到独立历史文本，显示宇宙旋转模型与该词汇选择有关；仅凭词源不足。

claim.en: Cosmic-totality expressions may recruit ONE / TURN / CYCLE / ENCLOSE / SPACE / TIME more often than matched non-cosmic concepts.
claim.zh-Hans: 表达宇宙整体的词语，可能比匹配的非宇宙概念更频繁调用 ONE／TURN／CYCLE／ENCLOSE／SPACE／TIME。

counterexamples: Current examples are too few
Borrowing and genealogical dependence must be controlled

testability.en: Pre-register languages, etymological sources, semantic coding, genealogical controls and a comparison baseline.
testability.zh-Hans: 预注册语言样本、词源来源、语义编码、谱系控制与比较基线。

proposition.en: The universe is a poem written by existence itself.
proposition.zh-Hans: 宇宙是存在本身写下的一首诗。

evidence_boundary.en: Literature may explore freely, but it is not historical evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 文学可以自由展开，但不属于历史证据。

boundary.en: Featured for the semantic operation TURN / ROTATION; it is not the standard translation and no Latin–Chinese cognacy is claimed.

latin_decomposition.chain: Latin universus → UNI (unus) + VERS (versus ← vertere) → ONE + TURNED → WHOLE

note.en: Around, cycle, complete/all; semantically useful but outside the modern WO sound cluster.

note.en: Joining/closing models the result of bringing parts together, not TURN itself.

note.en: Complete/entire models the outcome WHOLE, not the turning operation.

boundary.en: This is a cognitive-geometric mapping, not the historical meaning of every form in the chain.

summary.en: The audible English sound comes through Middle English and Anglo-French from Latin sonus / sonare. French son and sonner continue the same Latin sound family. These histories are independent of Chinese 声 and 响.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语表示听觉的 sound 经中古英语、盎格鲁法语追溯至拉丁语 sonus／sonare；法语 son、sonner 延续同一拉丁声音词族。这些词史独立于汉语“声”“响”。

claim.en: Audible sound: Middle English soun ← Anglo-French son/sun ← Latin sonus, related to sonare ‘to sound.’
claim.zh-Hans: 听觉义 sound：中古英语 soun ← 盎格鲁法语 son／sun ← 拉丁语 sonus，并与 sonare“发声”相关。

claim.en: French son derives from Latin sonus; French sonner derives from Latin sonare.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 son 源自拉丁语 sonus；sonner 源自拉丁语 sonare。

summary.en: sound /saʊnd/ and 声 shēng share meaning and begin with sibilant consonants, but English /s/ and Mandarin sh /ʂ/ are not identical, and the remaining sounds do not regularly correspond.
summary.zh-Hans: sound /saʊnd/ 与“声”shēng 共享声音义并都以擦音起首，但英语 /s/ 与普通话 sh /ʂ/ 并不相同，其余声音也没有建立规律对应。

claim.en: The proposed relation is a modern sound–meaning resemblance, not a historical cognacy claim.

proposition.en: Architecture is frozen music.
proposition.zh-Hans: 那是凝固的音乐。

text.en: When the violin sounded, it was like a small stream flowing through the forest. As the violin's current rose, I was passing a majestic church. I saw its two round corner towers, its circular window, and tracery radiating like the sun. A saint extended his arms as though an angel were beckoning; behind him, a halo shone like another sun. Columns recalled an ancient Athenian temple. A gentleman in a top hat passed through the great doorway. The violin's rising and falling melody made me imagine a pair of immortal companions drifting down from the mountains of the Middle Ages. Was this music I had once known, or a composer's new work? Sunlight touched the church's marble wall and spread over it a pale layer of yellow. It was frozen music.
text.zh-Hans: 小提琴的声音响起时，仿佛森林里一条小小的溪水正在流动。琴声流淌的时候，我正路过一座雄伟的教堂。我看见教堂两座圆形角楼的顶，也看见那扇圆窗，以及像太阳般向四方放射的窗棂。一位圣人伸开双臂，仿佛天使正在招手；他身后的光环，又像一轮太阳。那些圆柱使人想起古老的雅典神庙。一位戴着礼帽的绅士从大门走过。小提琴起伏的旋律，使我想象一双仙侣从中世纪的山间漂流而来。那是我曾经熟悉的音乐，还是作曲家的新作呢？太阳照着教堂大理石的外墙，又为它涂上一层淡淡的黄色。那是凝固的音乐。

evidence_boundary.en: The violin, forest stream, church, sun, saint and frozen music are literary images. They are not historical or phonetic evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 小提琴、森林溪流、教堂、太阳、圣人与“凝固的音乐”均属文学意象，不构成历史或语音证据。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Cross-language semantic candidate

rationale.en: The modern forms share an approximate /laɪ/ sequence, while their lexical meanings differ. This motivates a testable LIGHT ↔ SOUND/MUSIC cross-modal comparison rather than an etymological claim.
rationale.zh-Hans: 两个现代读音共享近似 /laɪ/ 序列，但直接词义不同；这支持提出可检验的 LIGHT ↔ SOUND／MUSIC 跨模态比较，而不是词源主张。

summary.en: Historical word histories are evaluated independently from the cross-language mapping.
summary.zh-Hans: 各语言的历史词源独立于跨语言 mapping 评估。

claim.en: The brightness noun is inherited through Germanic and is not a Latin borrowing. The homographic not-heavy adjective belongs to PIE *legwh- and is out of scope.
claim.zh-Hans: 表示光明的名词经日耳曼语传承，并非拉丁语借词；同形的“重量轻”形容词属于 PIE *legwh-，不在本条范围内。

claim.en: French lumière follows the luminaria/luminare/lumen line. Latin lux is a related family member, not an intermediate stage in lumière.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 lumière 沿 luminaria／luminare／lumen 谱系发展；拉丁语 lux 是相关词族成员，不是 lumière 的中间环节。

claim.en: The Chinese word belongs to an instrument-and-sound history. No historical cognacy or borrowing with English light is established.
claim.zh-Hans: 汉语“籟／籁”属于乐器—声音历史系统；没有证据证明其与英语 light 历史同源或存在借词关系。

proposition.en: Civilization is behind you, and you are its bearer.
proposition.zh-Hans: 文明在你的背后，而你是文明的载体。

text.en: People of the civilized world, who have moved from place to place from ancient times until today—you are the bearers of civilization; civilization stands behind you. Loving you has nothing to do with you. I want to do something for my people; that feeling is my own intention. Your arrival was, within the reach of my sight, something that ought to come. If you are the spark that kindled warmth across my earth, may we also say that the spark chose you as its bearer? I am a fruit nearing ripeness, bright and radiant beneath your sunlight.
text.zh-Hans: 那自古至今不断变换地方的，文明世界的人啊，你是文明的载体，文明在你的背后。爱你，与你无关；我想为我的人们做事，那种情感，是我自己的本意。你的来到，在我的眼界中，是你应该来临的。如果说你是我的火种，点燃了我的大地的温暖，那是否可以说，那火种以你为载体？我是那快要成熟的果啊，在你的阳光下，明媚灿烂。

summary.en: Middle English abandounen (English verb attested in the 14th century) was borrowed from Anglo-French abanduner, derived from abandun and a bandun, referring to power or disposal. Continental Old French à bandon likewise concerns disposal; abandonner is derived from abandon (CNRTL records releasing a rein around 1100 and leaving entirely from the 12th century). This supports the development toward relinquish/give up. It is not historically ban + donner. Bandon belongs to a Germanic command/jurisdiction background; this is not the author’s modern segmentation. Bandon itself means power/authority, not release. The displayed pathway is a semantic abstraction, not a strict chronology of first attestations.
summary.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abandounen（英语动词见于14世纪）借自盎格鲁法语 abanduner，后者由 abandun 及 a bandun 发展，涉及支配与处置。欧洲大陆古法语 à bandon 同样涉及任其处置；abandonner 派生自 abandon（CNRTL 记约1100年的松开缰绳义及12世纪起的完全离开义）。这支持向 relinquish/give up 的语义发展。历史上不是 ban + donner。bandon 具有日耳曼语命令／管辖词族背景，但不是作者提出的现代拆分。 bandon 本身为权力／支配，不是释放。展示路径是语义抽象，不是首见年代的严格序列。

claim.en: English ban (verb) continues Old English bannan, a Germanic proclamation/command verb; Middle English prohibitive senses reflect Norse influence, with later French/Latin influence. The English noun partly derives from the verb and partly from Anglo-French. French ban /bɑ̃/ is a masculine noun of Old Low Franconian origin: public proclamation, feudal summons/jurisdiction, banns, and exclusion in expressions such as mettre au ban. It is not the ordinary French verb “to prohibit” (interdire); the old note’s French ban v. 禁止 is corrected. This distinction does not cancel the independently proposed English ban ↔ 甭 candidate.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语动词 ban 承自古英语 bannan，属于日耳曼语宣告／命令词族；中古英语禁止等义受古诺斯语影响，后又受法语／拉丁语影响。英语名词部分来自动词，部分借自盎格鲁法语。法语 ban /bɑ̃/ 为阳性名词，源于古低地法兰克语，涉及公告、封建征召／管辖、婚姻公告及 mettre au ban 等排斥用语；它不是通常表示“禁止”的法语动词（interdire）。旧笔记“法语 ban v. 禁止”已纠正，这不取消独立的英语 ban ↔ 甭 候选。

claim.en: English banal is borrowed from French (Merriam-Webster: first known English use 1825). CNRTL traces French banal to feudal ban plus -al, with bannel attested in 1247 and the very common/unoriginal sense in 1798. Merriam-Webster describes a Medieval Latin bannalis route for Old French bannel. Both accounts connect seigneurial jurisdiction and shared-use facilities with the later commonplace sense. Neither derives it from Chinese. Ban and banal are separately evaluated observations, but their related European histories must be deduplicated in any family-based experiment.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 banal 借自法语（Merriam-Webster 记英语首见1825年）。CNRTL 将法语 banal 分析为封建法 ban 加 -al，记1247年 bannel 及1798年的极普通／无新意义；Merriam-Webster 则通过中古拉丁语 bannalis 解释古法语 bannel。两者均联系领主管辖、共同使用设施与后来的平常义，不从汉语倒推词史。ban 和 banal 的观察独立评价，但欧洲词史相关，实验按词源家族去重。

claim.en: Compare the /b/ after initial /ə/ in English abandon with Mandarin f /f/ in fàng: b ↔ f falls within the proposed b-p-m-f group. This is a medial-to-initial segment comparison, not whole-word homophony; voicing, place/manner, remaining segments and tone differ. Group membership does not prove a sound law or historical relation.
claim.zh-Hans: 比较英语 abandon 起始 /ə/ 后的 /b/ 与普通话 fàng 的 f /f/：b ↔ f 落入候选 b-p-m-f 组。这是词中到词首的片段比较，不是整词同音；清浊、发音部位／方式、其余音段及声调存在差异。同组不证明音变规律或历史关系。

claim.en: Whole-word mapping: abandon ↔ 放 fàng. Select 放 for LET GO / RELEASE before comparing sound. CNRTL records release of a rein around 1100 in the French history, and Chinese 放 has an independently documented release sense. This is a scoped historical-semantic bridge, not a claim that 放 alone translates every modern use of abandon.
claim.zh-Hans: 整词映射：abandon ↔ 放 fàng。先按 LET GO／RELEASE 选择“放”，再比较声音。CNRTL 记法语词史中约1100年的松开缰绳义；汉语“放”另有独立的释放义证据。这是限定语义的历时联系，不表示单字“放”可翻译 abandon 的所有现代用法。

claim.en: English ban ↔ 甭 béng: Phonetic-Semantic Candidate; semantic strength moderate; overall confidence Low; Historical Relation: Not claimed. The overlap is contextual DON’T / DO NOT / PROHIBIT. English ban often means formal prohibition; 甭 commonly means no need/do not and need not prohibit. English /bæn/ and béng show an author-observed labial onset and loose rhyme resemblance, not homophony: Pinyin b is unaspirated /p/, English b is /b/, final /n/ versus /ŋ/, vowels and tone differ.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 ban ↔ 甭 béng：Phonetic-Semantic Candidate；语义强度 moderate，整体置信度 Low；Historical Relation: Not claimed。交点限于语境中的 DON’T / DO NOT / PROHIBIT。ban 常表正式禁止，“甭”常表不用／不必／不要，不总是禁止。/bæn/ 与 béng 的双唇起音及宽泛韵部近似仅为作者观察，并非同音：拼音 b 为不送气 /p/，英语 b 为 /b/，韵尾 /n/ 与 /ŋ/、元音和声调有别。

claim.en: banal ↔ 般 bān / 一般: Phonetic-Semantic Candidate; semantic strength moderate; overall confidence Low; Historical Relation: Not claimed. The semantic anchor is the word 一般 in its ordinary/common sense, not an assertion that isolated 般 always means ordinary. Modern banal often adds a negative sense of unoriginal or trite that 一般 need not carry. French /ba.nal/ permits a partial ban- versus bān comparison; English pronunciations vary. Unmatched /al/, vowels, voicing and Mandarin tone remain limitations.
claim.zh-Hans: banal ↔ 般 bān / 一般：Phonetic-Semantic Candidate；语义强度 moderate，整体置信度 Low；Historical Relation: Not claimed。语义依据是“一般”的普通／通常义，不主张单字“般”总有普通义。现代 banal 常含陈腐、无新意的贬义，“一般”未必如此。法语 /ba.nal/ 可与 bān 作局部 ban- 音近观察；英语有多种读法。未对应的 /al/、元音、清浊与汉语声调仍是限制。

claim.en: Bandon means POWER/AUTHORITY; disposal belongs to the relational phrase à bandon. Modern 办/辦 means handle/manage, prepare or deal with. 说文新附 glosses 辦 as exert effort (致力), not authority. Thus bandon ↔ 办 is a limited control/handling association: Low semantic fit for POWER/AUTHORITY, Medium only for a contextual handling/disposal comparison. It is not an exact root translation. 权柄 is the stronger meaning-first support for authority regardless of its sound.
claim.zh-Hans: bandon 的核心是 POWER/AUTHORITY；任其处置关系属于 à bandon。现代办／辦为处理、办理、筹备等；《说文新附》释辦为致力，不是权力。因此 bandon ↔ 办仅保留为支配／办理的有限联系：对权力本义语义适配 Low，只有在处理／处置语境比较时为 Medium，不是词根的精确译词。权柄是更合适的权力义支持，其声音不决定选择。

claim.en: b ↔ b → same consonant / within b-p-m-f group is the author’s comparison label. It compares the initial b of bandon with Pinyin b in bàn. Pinyin b represents unaspirated /p/; the label is not proof of identical phonetic realization, homophony, or a historical sound law. A source-specific historical French pronunciation and the remaining consonants, vowels and tone still need independent assessment. Group fit cannot upgrade weak semantics.
claim.zh-Hans: b ↔ b → same consonant / within b-p-m-f group 是作者的对应标签：比较 bandon 的词首 b 与 bàn 的拼音 b。拼音 b 表示不送气 /p/；此标签不证明实际音值完全相同、同音或历史音变规律。古法语具体时期的读音及其余辅音、元音、汉语声调仍须独立评估。落入预测组不能提升较弱的语义证据。

claim.en: donner ↔ 捅: Weak Active Association / Original Author Association, not a primary mapping. French donner means give and descends from Latin donare. The supplied “捅钱 = 给钱” and reading tōng remain Original Author Usage Observation; standard Mandarin dictionaries give 捅 tǒng (poke/pierce, reveal, provoke), not a verified stable give sense. The targeted dictionary/dialect search did not establish that sense; this is a bounded evidence gap, not proof that no speaker uses it. Historical Relation: Not claimed. Donner is not a historical component of abandon.

editorial_notes.en: Translation Status ≠ Mapping Status ≠ Historical Relation ≠ Active Association Status. editorial_notes.en: The old a- = absence and band = group mnemonic, donate and 动 remain raw-note observations without new records or experimental promotion. Ban/banal historical relatedness requires family deduplication; no controlled result is claimed.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 旧 a-＝没有、band＝帮伙记忆法以及 donate、动保留为原始观察，不另建记录或提升实验等级。ban／banal 词史关联须作家族去重；不声称已有对照实验结果。

editorial_notes.en: Meaning first, consonant second.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 先定语义，再验辅音。

editorial_notes.en: Semantic Path studies how one word’s historical meanings develop. Consonant Group Mapping compares an English/French historical word or root with the pronunciation of a semantically selected Chinese candidate. These are independent analyses. The b-p-m-f, d-t-n-l, g-k-h and z-c-s groups predict cross-language sound correspondences, not membership of every Chinese word in one path.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: Semantic Path 研究一个词的历史语义怎样发展。Consonant Group Mapping 比较英／法历史词或词根与按语义选出的汉语候选词读音。两者独立；b-p-m-f、d-t-n-l、g-k-h、z-c-s 等组预测跨语言声音对应，不要求汉语路径中的每个字属于同组。

editorial_notes.en: The earlier Chinese same-group path design was an implementation error and has been withdrawn. Its path scores and planned path-constraint experiment are superseded, not evidence against the author’s cross-language hypothesis. This is retrospective editorial review, not a blinded study; no experiment has run.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 此前要求汉语全链同组的设计属于实现误解，已撤下；相应路径评分与路径约束实验计划作废，不构成对作者跨语言假说的反证。本次为回顾性编辑核验，不是盲评，未运行实验。

editorial_notes.en: Dialect & Diachronic Chinese Evidence is a separate evidence track. Record dialect/location/date and transcription separately from Middle Chinese or Old Chinese reconstructions, with named sources and reconstruction systems. Modern dialects are not frozen copies of ancient Chinese. No dialect or reconstructed pronunciation is used to raise this candidate’s grade; these comparisons remain pending.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: Dialect & Diachronic Chinese Evidence｜汉语方言与历时音韵证据独立记录。方言须注明地点、年代与转写；中古音／上古音须注明来源与重构体系，不能混用。现代方言不是古汉语的冻结复制品。本候选未以方言或重构音提高等级，相关比较待核验。

editorial_notes.en: abash ↔ 怕 pà (medial b ↔ p) and bash ↔ 拍 pāi (initial b ↔ p) are two other separately identified Candidate observations. Sharing b-p-m-f does not make them prove each other or bandon ↔ 办. Statistical independence requires etymological-family review; count related derivatives once.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: abash ↔ 怕 pà（词中 b ↔ p）与 bash ↔ 拍 pāi（词首 b ↔ p）是另外两个分别记录的 Candidate 观察。共享 b-p-m-f 不使它们互相证明，也不证明 bandon ↔ 办；统计独立性仍需词源家族核验，同源派生须去重。

source.raw_note:
abandon，放弃。甭 beng。ban 与甭同音。

2026-09-07 作者补充全文（保留词义／拆分／拼写；仅去除界面 Search 与 HTML 格式）：
abandon，放弃。甭beng。ban与甭同音
英語
abandon [ə'bændən] v. 放弃 [<法语]
a.ban.don
abandonment [ə'bændənmənt] n. 抛弃 [<法语]
ban [bæn] v. 禁止 [<法语]
banal [banal] a. 一般的，平凡.般。可以对应般ban
band n. 一帮，一伙
法語
abandonner [abandonner] v. 抛弃
a.ban.don.ner
ban v. 禁止。可以用甭beng这个字代表。
donner v. 送。用捅tong字对应，给谁的意思，捅钱。
漢語
甭【beng】v. 用法语ban禁止对应，英语ban禁止对应。
旁【pang】n. 旁边的旁字变成使动的用法，放到一旁，抛弃。与法语ban禁止对应，英语ban禁止对应。这里给一个可能性而已。
捅【tong】v. 给的意思。与法语donner给字对应，与英语donate给予对应。
动【dong】v.
备注：为什么这里分开ban而不是band，因为这个词从法语来，法语里面没有band这个词，是bande包扎。法语中有ban禁止，interdict禁止。法语donner，给的意思。合起来就是禁止给=放弃。如果仅仅从英语角度也可以有这样的解释：a- [a] pref. 没有的意思，用罢ba字对应。band [band] n. 帮伙。不过仅仅是记忆方便这样说，因为这个词从法语而来最后还是从法语角度介绍为好。现在考虑abadon这个词

featured_mapping.display_label: Whole-word mapping · 整词映射 · LET GO / RELEASE → 放 · b ↔ f Candidate

boundary.en: Whole-word mapping: abandon ↔ 放 fàng. Select 放 for LET GO / RELEASE before comparing sound. CNRTL records release of a rein around 1100 in the French history, and Chinese 放 has an independently documented release sense. This is a scoped historical-semantic bridge, not a claim that 放 alone translates every modern use of abandon.
boundary.zh-Hans: 整词映射：abandon ↔ 放 fàng。先按 LET GO／RELEASE 选择“放”，再比较声音。CNRTL 记法语词史中约1100年的松开缰绳义；汉语“放”另有独立的释放义证据。这是限定语义的历时联系，不表示单字“放”可翻译 abandon 的所有现代用法。

semantic_evaluation.en: Bandon means POWER/AUTHORITY; disposal belongs to the relational phrase à bandon. Modern 办/辦 means handle/manage, prepare or deal with. 说文新附 glosses 辦 as exert effort (致力), not authority. Thus bandon ↔ 办 is a limited control/handling association: Low semantic fit for POWER/AUTHORITY, Medium only for a contextual handling/disposal comparison. It is not an exact root translation. 权柄 is the stronger meaning-first support for authority regardless of its sound.
semantic_evaluation.zh-Hans: bandon 的核心是 POWER/AUTHORITY；任其处置关系属于 à bandon。现代办／辦为处理、办理、筹备等；《说文新附》释辦为致力，不是权力。因此 bandon ↔ 办仅保留为支配／办理的有限联系：对权力本义语义适配 Low，只有在处理／处置语境比较时为 Medium，不是词根的精确译词。权柄是更合适的权力义支持，其声音不决定选择。

Etymonline proposes Scandinavian or echoic possibilities for violent-hit bash and dates it to the 1640s; Merriam-Webster lists origin unknown and first use 1744. Preserve this source difference rather than claiming a settled date or total unrelatedness.

summary.en: ABASH ↔ BASH — Active Association / Cognitive Bridge. Author-proposed by Jinkai Liu; Cognitive / Pedagogical / Creative method, NOT historical evidence. A learner may imagine BASH as sudden physical impact and ABASH as being made embarrassed/disconcerted: PHYSICAL IMPACT → PSYCHOLOGICAL DISCONCERT. This mnemonic is neither a definition of abash nor a claim that embarrassment requires a physical blow. Historical relation (abash / violent-hit bash): unestablished / not derived in this analysis; not a- + bash(hit). supporting_cases: Author’s preserved cognitive association only; no historical derivation established
counterexamples: The legacy Chinese gloss is narrowed: modern abash means embarrass/disconcert, not merely surprise.
No regular cross-language sound correspondence has been demonstrated.

Merriam-Webster documents obsolete bash “be abashed”, from Middle English basshen shortened from abasshen, behind bashful. This is not evidence that violent-hit bash developed into abash. Etymonline proposes Scandinavian or echoic possibilities for violent-hit bash and dates it to the 1640s; Merriam-Webster lists origin unknown and first use 1744. Preserve this source difference rather than claiming a settled date or total unrelatedness.

Experiment Status: Planned / Not run; no results.

project_note.en: Collanguage imagines a bridge through which English and French speech may be heard as musical Chinese in a future spacefaring age.
project_note.zh-Hans: 通语 Collanguage 想象一座语言桥梁：面向未来宇航时代，英语与法语可以转化成高低错落、如音乐般的汉语。

title.en: A Bridge Toward the Spacefaring Age
title.zh-Hans: 通向宇航时代的语言桥梁

text.zh-Hant: 架起語言之間的橋梁，讓我們面對未來的宇航時代。當你聽別人說出英語、法語的時候，由於有通語 Collanguage 所建立的規則與想像，你會自動把語句轉化成高低錯落、如音樂般的漢語，實現一種美好的交流。考慮文化因素，把漢語拼音用於跨語系的語言研究，這就是《語言書》Languagesbook 所探尋和追求的。它可以把兩件原本不相干的事情聯繫起來；在文學與想像中，這種聯繫不必先具備嚴格的歷史邏輯。我在我的葡萄園裡，瑪娜花盛開。
text.en: By building bridges between languages, we prepare ourselves for the spacefaring age ahead. When you hear someone speaking English or French, the rules and imagination developed through Collanguage may let you transform the utterance into Chinese, rising and falling like music, and thus create a beautiful exchange. To bring Chinese pinyin into cross-language-family research while attending to culture: this is what Languagesbook seeks. It may connect two things that at first seem unrelated; in literature and imagination, such a connection need not begin with strict historical logic. In my vineyard, the Mana flowers are in bloom.

evidence_boundary.en: The bridge, musical transformation and vineyard are the author's literary and methodological vision. They do not establish phonetic correspondence, cognacy or the historical segmentation a + bash.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 语言桥梁、音乐式转化与葡萄园属于作者的文学及方法论愿景；它们不能证明规律语音对应、同源关系或 a＋bash 的历史切分。

summary.en: Rechecked 2026-09-07: Merriam-Webster gives Middle English abaissen/abaschen, from Anglo-French abaiss- / abair, an alteration of esbaer (Continental Old French esbahir). American Heritage also gives Old French esbahir; Etymonline treats the deeper gaping/imitative explanation as tentative. Abahir is not a Latin etymon. For violent-hit bash, Merriam-Webster lists origin unknown; Etymonline suggests Scandinavian or echoic possibilities, not a secure Old English origin. Standard analyses do not support modern a- + bash(hit); spelling similarity is not derivational evidence, and does not establish absolute unrelatedness.

claim.en: Merriam-Webster documents obsolete bash “be abashed”, from Middle English basshen shortened from abasshen, behind bashful. This is not evidence that violent-hit bash developed into abash. meaning.en: Standard Translation: abbey → 修道院 / 修院 · Supported. Root Mapping Candidate: ABBA ↔ 爸 bà (FATHER). Kinship control: early-child speech resemblance; historical Aramaic–Chinese relation Not claimed.

rationale.en: The institution meaning and the FATHER root candidate are independently classified. Meaning first, consonant second. The abbey translation does not change to 爸.

summary.en: English abbey came through Middle English and Anglo-French from Medieval Latin abbātia. The base title abbās/abbot ultimately reflects Aramaic abba ‘father’ through ecclesiastical Greek and Christian Latin. This supports an indirect historical connection to Abba, not a direct borrowing from a modern Jewish form and not a relation to Chinese bi/bei.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey 经中古英语和盎格鲁-法语进入，来源是中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。其基础称谓 abbās／abbot 又经教会希腊语和基督教拉丁语上溯至阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。这说明它与 Abba 有间接的深层词史联系，并非直接借自某个现代犹太教形式，也不证明与汉语 bi／bei 有历史关系。

claim.en: Middle English abbeye/abbay was borrowed from Anglo-French abeie/abbaye, from Medieval Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abbeye／abbay 借自盎格鲁-法语 abeie／abbaye，后者来自中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。

claim.en: French abbé comes from Christian Latin abbās, transmitted through ecclesiastical Greek from Aramaic abba ‘father’; abbaye is derived from that abbatial title through Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbé 来自基督教拉丁语 abbās；该称谓经教会希腊语源自阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。abbaye 则经拉丁语 abbātia 从这一院长称谓派生。

claim.en: French abbesse is borrowed from Christian Latin abbatissa, a derivative of abbas, and names the female head of an abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbesse 借自基督教拉丁语 abbatissa，是 abbas 的派生词，指女修道院院长。

claim.en: CNRTL distinguishes abbatia as office/dignity of an abbot from the monastery sense. The requested Late Latin label and Merriam-Webster’s Medieval Latin label are retained with source attribution.

ABBA ↔ 爸 is a root-level Phonetic-Semantic Candidate, not abbey’s translation and not evidence of Aramaic–Chinese cognacy. Historical Relation: Not claimed. This control is not a demonstrated origin story for this particular pair.

claim.en: Select 爸 for FATHER before inspecting sound; retain 父 / 爹 / 爷 as semantic alternatives even outside the proposed group.
claim.zh-Hans: 先按 FATHER 选择爸，再检查声音；父／爹／爷作为语义备选保留，不因不符合辅音组而排除。

claim.en: abbey-final /bi/ and 比/笔 bǐ /pi/ share a high front vowel and a labial stop, but differ in voicing/phonological system, syllable position and Mandarin tone.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 词尾 /bi/ 与“比／笔”bǐ /pi/ 共享高前元音与唇塞音，但在浊音／音系、音节位置及普通话声调上不同。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/ and 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯/ offer a loose auditory resemblance, but no regular historical correspondence or independent lexical-semantic match has been shown.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/ 与“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯/ 有宽泛听感近似，但尚无规律历史对应或独立词义对应。

summary.en: The standard concept is a monastic institution/community. Spiritual cultivation as growth is a plausible interpretive frame, but the bud-to-rose transformation belongs to the literary layer.
summary.zh-Hans: 标准概念是修道机构／共同体。“灵魂修持如成长”可作解释性框架，但“蓓蕾长成玫瑰”的转换属于文学层。

summary.en: The 比, 笔 and 蓓 comparisons are retained as separately graded author observations. None is historical evidence or a replacement for 修道院.
summary.zh-Hans: “比”“笔”“蓓”的比较作为分别分级的作者观察保留；均不是历史证据，也不替代“修道院”。

claim.en: 比 bǐ is a phonetic candidate only; no supporting abbey-related lexical meaning is recorded.
claim.zh-Hans: “比”bǐ 仅为声音候选；未记录与修道院相关的支持性词义。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ is a weak/speculative observation. The proposed ‘using a pen’ interpretation lacks an independently established semantic bridge to abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 是弱／推测性观察。“用笔”的解释缺少独立成立的语义桥梁。

claim.en: 蓓 bèi / 蓓蕾 is a literary phonetic-semantic association: an abbey imagined as a place where the soul develops like a rosebud.
claim.zh-Hans: “蓓”bèi／“蓓蕾”是文学性的声音—语义联想：把修道院想象为灵魂如玫瑰蓓蕾般成长之所。

claim.en: English abbey /ˈæbi/ ends in /bi/, while Mandarin 比 and 笔 are bǐ /pi˨˩˦/.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey /ˈæbi/ 以 /bi/ 结尾；普通话“比”“笔”为 bǐ /pi˨˩˦/。

limitations.en: This is a surface resemblance, not a demonstrated sound law. English /b/ and Mandarin pinyin b represent different phonetic categories, and Mandarin tone has no counterpart here.
limitations.zh-Hans: 这是表面音似，不是已证明的音变规律。英语 /b/ 与普通话拼音 b 所代表的语音范畴不同，普通话声调在此也无对应。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/, abbé /a.be/ and abbesse /a.bɛs/ share the historical abb-/ab- family; 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ only resembles part of these modern sounds.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/、abbé /a.be/、abbesse /a.bɛs/ 属于有词史关系的 abb-／ab- 词族；“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ 只与部分现代音形近似。

limitations.en: The relation among the French forms is historical; their resemblance to Chinese bei is not. Surface similarity must not be transferred across those two claims.
limitations.zh-Hans: 法语各形式之间有历史关系；它们与汉语 bei 的近似没有已证历史关系。不能把前一事实转移成后一结论。

semantic_structure.relation: RELIGIOUS INSTITUTION → MONASTIC COMMUNITY; literary extension: SPIRITUAL CULTIVATION → GROWTH

claim.en: The final syllable of abbey may invite a phonetic association with 比 bǐ, without a semantic or historical claim.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 的末音节可能引发与“比”bǐ 的声音联想，但不提出语义或历史关系主张。

counterexamples: No abbey-related lexical meaning in 比
English voicing vs Mandarin aspiration contrast
Unmatched tone and first syllable

testability.en: Use blinded similarity ratings with unrelated /bi, pi, bei/ controls; semantic support must be tested separately.
testability.zh-Hans: 可用盲法相似度评分，并加入无关 /bi、pi、bei/ 负对照；语义支持必须另行检验。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ may be heard as similar to abbey-final /bi/, but ‘using a pen’ does not currently supply a supported abbey meaning.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 在听感上可能接近 abbey 词尾 /bi/，但“用笔”目前不能提供有支持的修道院词义。

counterexamples: No independent semantic bridge
Many unrelated words can share /bi/-like syllables
Not a standard translation

testability.en: Require a preregistered semantic criterion and negative controls before promotion; otherwise retain as a weak observation.
testability.zh-Hans: 升级前须预先注册语义判据并设置负对照；否则只保留为弱观察。

claim.en: Abbaye/abbey and 蓓 bèi can support a literary image of an abbey as a place where the soul grows like a bud, without etymological force.
claim.zh-Hans: abbaye／abbey 与“蓓”bèi 可支持“修道院如灵魂蓓蕾成长之所”的文学意象，但不具有词源证明力。

counterexamples: No demonstrated historical correspondence
蓓蕾 is not the standard translation of abbey
Metaphorical meaning supplied by the author

testability.en: Evaluate as literary reception or mnemonic association, not as an etymological hypothesis.
testability.zh-Hans: 应作为文学接受或记忆联想评价，而不是词源假说。

proposition.en: An abbey is a place where the soul is cultivated like a bud opening toward a rose.
proposition.zh-Hans: 修道院如灵魂的蓓蕾之所，在修持中向玫瑰生长。

evidence_boundary.en: The bud, rose and spiritual-growth image is authored literature. It is searchable and preserved, but it is not lexical translation, historical etymology or independent semantic evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 蓓蕾、玫瑰与灵魂成长的意象属于作者文学创作。它可检索、被保留，但不是词义翻译、历史词源或独立语义证据。

source.author: Jinkai Liu
source.normalization: French spelling normalized to abbaye/abbé/abbesse and HTML entities decoded; the research ideas are not overwritten.
source.raw_note: 英语：abbey ['æbi] n. 修道院。法语：abbaye n. 修道院；abbé n. 修道院院长；abbesse n. 女修道院院长。汉语候选：比 bi；笔 bi；以及文学候选‘蓓 bei／蓓蕾’。解释：这个词应该从犹太教的阿比而来。而比或许是用笔 bi 的意思。或者解释成蓓 bei、蓓蕾；这里用一个蓓蕾的蓓字对应，因为修道院是人的灵魂的修持，而生长出绚丽的玫瑰的蓓蕾的圣所。

source.language: Aramaic historical root · Root Mapping Candidate

gloss.en: FATHER root candidate; abbey translates as 修道院 / 修院
gloss.zh-Hans: 父亲义的词根候选；abbey 标准翻译为修道院／修院

meaning.en: Kinship control: recurrent early-child / baby-talk articulatory patterns are an alternative explanation for similar father/mother terms across languages. ABBA ↔ 爸 is a root-level Phonetic-Semantic Candidate, not abbey’s translation and not evidence of Aramaic–Chinese cognacy. Historical Relation: Not claimed. This control is not a demonstrated origin story for this particular pair.
meaning.zh-Hans: 亲属称谓控制：跨语言父母称谓常出现相似的早期儿童／婴儿语发音模式，构成替代解释。ABBA ↔ 爸是词根级音义候选，不是 abbey 的标准翻译，也不是阿拉姆语与汉语历史同源的证据。Historical Relation: Not claimed。控制因素不等于已证明此词对的具体起源。

recalibration.principle: Meaning first, consonant second.｜先定语义，再验辅音。
recalibration.historical_path: English abbey ← Anglo-French / Old French abbeie / abaïe (also abeie / abbaye) ← Late / Medieval ecclesiastical Latin abbatia ← Latin abbas ← Greek abbas ← Aramaic abba “father / my father”
recalibration.semantic_path: ABBA (FATHER) → ABBAS / ABBOT / ABBÉ (SPIRITUAL FATHER / MONASTIC SUPERIOR) → ABBATIA / ABBAYE / ABBEY (office/institution → monastery)

path_boundary.en: This is a family/semantic summary, not a linear borrowing chain through every slash-separated form. French abbé and English abbot are parallel descendants of the title family. CNRTL distinguishes abbatia as abbatial office/dignity and as monastery. Merriam-Webster labels abbatia Medieval Latin; Etymonline calls it Late Latin. Father is the shared dictionary gloss; my father is Etymonline’s gloss, not a claim that every occurrence has possessive morphology.
path_boundary.zh-Hans: 这是词族／语义概括，不是所有斜线词形之间依次借入。法语 abbé 与英语 abbot 是称谓词族的分支。CNRTL 区分 abbatia 的院长职务／尊位义与修道院义。Merriam-Webster 标中世纪拉丁语，Etymonline 标晚期拉丁语。father 是共同释义；my father 按 Etymonline 归属，不断言每一用例都具有所有格形态。

independent_correction.en: The family ultimately traces to Aramaic abba via Greek and Latin, with French and English branches. Abbey is an English institution word, not a Jewish-language name or a Jewish title for a pastor.
independent_correction.zh-Hans: 该词族最终经希腊语和拉丁语追溯至阿拉姆语 abba，形成法语和英语分支。abbey 是英语机构词，不是“犹太语 abbey”或“犹太人称牧师 abbey”。

kinship_research_note.status: Scoped mainland platform and scholarly evidence; earliest dating and named reconstructions remain pending

note.en: 父 / 爸 / 爹 / 爷 vary by period, region, dialect and register. Current mainland platform entries document their differentiated senses, while an official research-project report reproduces local-gazetteer evidence of 爹 / 爷 / 爸 as regional father terms. This supports diversity, not a universal replacement timeline or an earliest national attestation. Modern dialects are living diachronic evidence windows, not frozen copies of ancient Chinese.
note.zh-Hans: 父／爸／爹／爷随时期、地域、方言与语体而异。大陆现行数字辞书条目记录其分层义项，国家社科基金项目报告所引地方志材料还显示爹／爷／爸作为地域父称并存。这支持多样性，不证明全国统一替代时间线或全国最早书证。现代方言是活态历时证据窗口，不是古汉语的冻结复制品。

summary.en: English abbreviate continues Middle English abbreviaten, borrowed from Late Latin abbreviātus, participle of abbreviāre, ultimately based on brevis (short). French abréger also goes back to abbreviare; French abréviation is borrowed from Latin abbreviatio. English abbreviation came through Anglo-French abreviation from Latin abbreviātiō: a related noun, not merely an English suffix added to the modern verb.

phonetic_observation.scope: Historical-unit Latin brev-/brevi- compared with modern Mandarin; modern English reflex listed separately
phonetic_observation.reference_system: Approximate Roman reference from Allen & Greenough §8; broad IPA editorial inference. No uniform Late Latin realization or ancient Chinese reconstruction asserted.

consonants.en: Latin /b/ and English /b/ are voiced bilabial stops; Mandarin pinyin b is voiceless unaspirated [p]. Latin r and consonantal v [w], and English /r,v/, have no counterparts in biě. A b-p-m-f group hit is only a cross-language hypothesis.
consonants.zh-Hans: 拉丁和英语 /b/ 为浊双唇塞音，拼音 b 为清不送气 [p]。拉丁 r、辅音 v [w] 及英语 /r,v/ 在 biě 中无对应；b-p-m-f 同组命中仅属跨语言假说。

vowel.en: Latin short e, represented here as [ɛ], partly resembles Mandarin [iɛ]; English stressed /iː/ is not [iɛ]. Latin brevi- also contains short i.
vowel.zh-Hans: 拉丁短 e（此处宽式记 [ɛ]）与普通话 [iɛ] 局部接近；英语重读 /iː/ 并非 [iɛ]；拉丁 brevi- 另含短 i。

syllables.en: brev- is an extracted stem fragment, not a complete word or independently stressed syllable; brevi- includes a following vowel. brevis has two syllables and abbreviate four; biě has one. The English spelling brev spans /briː.v/, not a single /brɛv/ syllable.
syllables.zh-Hans: brev- 为抽取词干片段，不是完整词或独立重读音节；brevi- 多一个元音。brevis 为两音节，abbreviate 为四音节，biě 为一音节。英语拼写 brev 跨 /briː.v/ 边界，不能按字母读成一个 /brɛv/ 音节。

stress.en: English abbreviate stresses /briː/; abbreviation shifts primary stress to /eɪ/. Extracted Latin stems have no independent word stress; stress of the host word must not be assigned to a root fragment.

summary.en: English abbreviation continues Middle English abbreviacioun, borrowed via Anglo-French abreviation from Late Latin abbreviātiō, from abbreviāre plus the action-noun suffix -tiō. consonants.en: Latin /b/ and English /b/ are voiced bilabial stops; Mandarin pinyin b is voiceless unaspirated [p]. Latin r and consonantal v [w], and English /r,v/, have no counterparts in biě. A b-p-m-f group hit is only a cross-language hypothesis.

vowel.en: Latin short e, represented here as [ɛ], partly resembles Mandarin [iɛ]; English stressed /iː/ is not [iɛ]. Latin brevi- also contains short i.

syllables.en: brev- is an extracted stem fragment, not a complete word or independently stressed syllable; brevi- includes a following vowel. brevis has two syllables and abbreviate four; biě has one. The English spelling brev spans /briː.v/, not a single /brɛv/ syllable.

stress.en: English abbreviate stresses /briː/; abbreviation shifts primary stress to /eɪ/. Extracted Latin stems have no independent word stress; stress of the host word must not be assigned to a root fragment.

tone.en: Mandarin biě has third tone (citation [214]); bié has second tone [35]. English stress and Latin vowel quantity do not match Mandarin lexical tone. Citation contours do not describe all connected-speech realizations.

phonetic_observation.reference_system: Allen & Greenough Roman reference (§§7–8), approximate classical pronunciation; broad IPA is editorial inference, not a recording.

onset.en: Reference Latin d [d], and English /d/ in -dicate, versus Mandarin t [tʰ]: broadly coronal stops, differing in voicing and aspiration. English /d/ is medial after /b/, not the word onset.
onset.zh-Hans: 参考拉丁 d [d]、英语 -dicate 中 /d/ 对普通话 t [tʰ]：同属宽泛舌冠塞音，清浊与送气不同；英语 /d/ 在 /b/ 后，非整词词首。

vowel.en: Latin short i differs from Mandarin /i/; dicāre also contains long ā and e. English /ɪ/ and /eɪ/ cannot be reduced to tí.
vowel.zh-Hans: 拉丁短 i 不等同普通话 /i/；dicāre 另有长 ā 与 e；英语 /ɪ/、/eɪ/ 不能缩成 tí。

consonants.en: Latin c [k] and r, and English /k,t/ plus initial /æb/, are unmatched in 啼.
consonants.zh-Hans: 拉丁 c [k]、r，以及英语 /k,t/ 和词首 /æb/ 在啼中无对应。

syllables.en: di-cā-re and English abdicate each have three syllables, versus one in tí.
syllables.zh-Hans: di-cā-re 与英语 abdicate 各三音节，对 tí 一音节。

tone.en: Mandarin tí has rising second tone; Latin vowel quantity/stress and English stress are not lexical-tone matches.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话 tí 为阳平升调；拉丁长短、重音及英语重音不等于汉语声调。

consonant_group.boundary: Not arbitrary interchange within Chinese; group hit is not historical proof.

rating.method: Unvalidated editorial rubric: coronal stop place/manner 4/10; limited front-vowel similarity 3/8; unmatched consonants 0/5; syllable structure 0/4; prosody 0/3. No empirical accuracy implied.

semantic_structure.relation: Modern: renounce office → 退位; historical unit: DECLARE ↔ cry/call (weak); literary: retire → fall silent

relation_to_entry.en: French borrows Latin abdicare; not thereby an established intermediary for English.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 法语借自拉丁 abdicare；不因此成为英语已证实的中介。

relation_to_entry.en: From dictāre, frequentative of dīcere; one related family, not independent evidence for Chinese.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 来自 dictāre，为 dīcere 的反复体；词族关联不作为独立汉语对应样本。

relation_to_entry.en: TLFi derives dicter from Latin dictare, frequentative of dicere.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: TLFi：dicter 借自 Latin dictare，为 dicere 的反复体。

relation_to_entry.en: From dīrigere: dis- + regere guide; not DIC-/DICT-.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 来自 dīrigere：dis- + regere 引导；非 DIC-/DICT-。

relation_to_entry.en: From Latin dīrēctiō, via dīrēctus, participle of dīrigere.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 来自 Latin dīrēctiō，经 dīrēctus（dīrigere 的分词）；非 DIC-/DICT-。

semantic_associations.relation: A ruler no longer making proclamations after renouncing office is a literary image that loosely echoes the historical SAY/DECLARE root.

claim.en: Compare historical dicāre with modern 啼 tí through d↔t in the proposed d-t-n-l group, only after independent semantic screening.
claim.zh-Hans: 先独立筛选语义，再以 d-t-n-l 跨语言候选组研究历史 dicāre 与现代啼 tí 的 d↔t。

proposition.en: To abdicate: to cry out no more.
proposition.zh-Hans: 退位，即不再啼叫。

explanation.zh-Hans: 在位者发号施令；退位者不再发声。文学意象，不是标准词源。

english_path.en: Merriam-Webster dates its first known English use to 1548 and derives it from Latin abdicātus, participle of abdicāre. AHD/OALD analyse ab- away/from + dicāre proclaim/declare. MW relates -dicāre by ablaut to dīc- in dīcere. These consulted accounts specify Latin borrowing, not a required French intermediary; earliest-use dating is source-specific.
english_path.zh-Hans: Merriam-Webster 所列最早英语用例为1548年，源于拉丁 abdicātus（abdicāre 的过去分词）。AHD／OALD 分析为 ab- 离开／自 + dicāre 宣布；MW 将 -dicāre 解释为 dīcere 中 dīc- 的元音交替派生形式。所核辞书指向拉丁借入，并未确立法语必经中介；最早年代限于该辞书记录。

french_path.en: TLFi records abdiquer circa 1375 in the renouncing-power sense and treats it as borrowed from Latin abdicare. Earlier French attestation alone does not establish the English borrowing route.
french_path.zh-Hans: TLFi 记录法语 abdiquer 约1375年的放弃权力用例，并注明借自拉丁 abdicare；法语出现较早不自动证明英语经法语借入。

latin_units.scope: proclaim/declare; the first-conjugation component; MW describes -dicāre as an ablaut derivative of dīc-.
say/speak/state; related third-conjugation verb, with long ī; not interchangeable with dicāre.
frequentative of dīcere; dictate/prescribe; source of dictate and French dicter.

ab_prefix.note: AWAY / OFF / FROM is the historical morpheme function, not the modern Chinese verb 放弃. Renounce/relinquish belongs to whole Latin abdicāre; 退 belongs to whole modern English abdicate.

french_surface_segmentation.suffix_boundary: Do not analyse -que as a general French suffix; the surface letters alone do not establish morpheme boundaries.

historical_calibration.explanatory_gloss_boundary: If declare away is used, it is an explanatory gloss / semantic aid, not a strict word-for-word Latin translation. No artificial 放弃 + 说 + 退 or double negation is inferred.

onset.en: Reference Latin d [d], and English /d/ in -dicate, versus Mandarin t [tʰ]: broadly coronal stops, differing in voicing and aspiration. English /d/ is medial after /b/, not the word onset.
onset.zh-Hans: 参考拉丁 d [d]、英语 -dicate 中 /d/ 对普通话 t [tʰ]：同属宽泛舌冠塞音，清浊与送气不同；英语 /d/ 在 /b/ 后，非整词词首。

vowel.en: Latin short i differs from Mandarin /i/; dicāre also contains long ā and e. English /ɪ/ and /eɪ/ cannot be reduced to tí.
vowel.zh-Hans: 拉丁短 i 不等同普通话 /i/；dicāre 另有长 ā 与 e；英语 /ɪ/、/eɪ/ 不能缩成 tí。

consonants.en: Latin c [k] and r, and English /k,t/ plus initial /æb/, are unmatched in 啼.
consonants.zh-Hans: 拉丁 c [k]、r，以及英语 /k,t/ 和词首 /æb/ 在啼中无对应。

syllables.en: di-cā-re and English abdicate each have three syllables, versus one in tí.
syllables.zh-Hans: di-cā-re 与英语 abdicate 各三音节，对 tí 一音节。

tone.en: Mandarin tí has rising second tone; Latin vowel quantity/stress and English stress are not lexical-tone matches.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话 tí 为阳平升调；拉丁长短、重音及英语重音不等于汉语声调。

title.zh-Hans: Abdomen · 腹部 · 肚子是我们的领地吗？

featured_mapping.display_label: Featured phonetic-semantic candidate · 特色音义候选

boundary.en: 肚 dù is shown first as a concise Chinese body-part candidate. The standard translation remains 腹部 / 肚子, and no common historical origin is claimed.
boundary.zh-Hans: 先展示单字“肚”dù，作为简洁的汉语身体词候选；通用翻译仍是“腹部／肚子”，不主张共同历史来源。

gloss.en: The part of the body between the thorax and pelvis; belly
gloss.zh-Hans: 胸部与骨盆之间的身体部位；腹部、肚子

meaning.en: 腹部/腹 is the standard formal translation; 肚子 is the standard everyday equivalent and the selected Chinese mapping. The isolated form 肚 dù is additionally preserved as an experimental phonetic-semantic candidate.
meaning.zh-Hans: “腹部／腹”是标准正式译法，“肚子”是标准日常对应词，也是本条选定的主要汉语 Mapping；单字“肚”dù 另作为实验性语音—语义候选保留。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Reviewed lexical equivalent with separate phonetic-semantic candidate

rationale.en: The ordinary lexical equivalence is strong in the BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY field. The sound comparison is independently low-confidence and does not imply common origin.
rationale.zh-Hans: 普通词义对应在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 语义场中明确成立；声音比较另列为低置信候选，不暗示共同来源。

summary.en: English and French abdomen are learned borrowings from Latin abdōmen, with the oblique stem abdōmin-. The deeper origin of the Latin word is uncertain. Therefore ab.dom.en is not accepted as a historical segmentation. English abdominal and French abdominal/abdominale are derivatives of abdomen, not evidence for a dom root shared with dome or domain.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语和法语 abdomen 都是源自拉丁语 abdōmen 的学术借词，其斜格词干为 abdōmin-。该拉丁词更深层来源仍不确定，因此不把 ab.dom.en 接受为历史构词切分。英语 abdominal 与法语 abdominal／abdominale 是 abdomen 的派生词，不能据此推出它们与 dome 或 domain 共享 dom 词根。

claim.en: English abdomen was borrowed from Middle French and Latin; Latin abdōmen meant the belly or paunch and is of uncertain origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen 借自中古法语与拉丁语；拉丁语 abdōmen 指腹部或大肚子，其来源不确定。

claim.en: French abdomen is a learned sixteenth-century borrowing from Latin abdomen; French abdominal is derived from French abdomen with the adjectival suffix -al.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abdomen 是十六世纪从拉丁语 abdomen 借入的学术词；法语 abdominal 由法语 abdomen 加形容词后缀 -al 派生。

claim.en: A derivation from Latin abdere ‘hide, conceal’ has been proposed, but major dictionary treatment regards it as doubtful; no deeper decomposition is asserted here.
claim.zh-Hans: 有人提出它可能与拉丁语 abdere“隐藏”有关，但主要词典认为这一解释可疑；本记录不主张任何更深层构词切分。

claim.en: Domain, domestic, dominant and dominate belong to a house/master family through Latin domus, dominus, dominium and dominari. Architectural dome follows a Greek/late-Latin/Romance building-roof path. These histories do not derive from abdomen or from a belly sense.
claim.zh-Hans: domain、domestic、dominant、dominate 经拉丁语 domus、dominus、dominium、dominari 属于“家屋／主人”词族。建筑义 dome 则走希腊语—晚期拉丁语—罗曼语的建筑／屋顶路径。这些词史都不源自 abdomen，也不源自“肚子”义。

summary.en: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ and 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ meet clearly in BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY meaning. Sound support is only partial: the second syllable begins with English /d/, while Mandarin pinyin d represents an unaspirated voiceless coronal stop [t]; abdomen also contains /b m n/ with no counterpart in 肚, and 肚 has lexical tone.
summary.zh-Hans: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 与“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 词义上明确相交。声音支持仅属局部：abdomen 第二音节以英语 /d/ 起首，而普通话拼音 d 表示不送气清冠音 [t]；abdomen 另有 /b m n/，在“肚”中无对应，并且“肚”带词汇声调。

claim.en: The proposed domen/dom ↔ 肚 comparison reduces to a partial coronal-stop resemblance plus a strong semantic intersection; it is not the same consonant skeleton.
claim.zh-Hans: 所提 domen／dom ↔“肚”的比较可归结为局部冠音塞音近似加明确语义交点；二者并不是相同的辅音骨架。

summary.en: The authorial chain ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL is a coherent imaginative model, not a historical derivation. The Chinese hand/control imagery is preserved as a cross-cultural cognitive note without expanding it into an origin claim.
summary.zh-Hans: 作者提出的 ROUND／CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL 是连贯的想象模型，不是历史派生链。汉语“手—支配”意象作为跨文化认知札记保留，不扩展成词源主张。

claim.en: A convex belly can be imagined through the shape of a dome and as a bodily container or personal domain.
claim.zh-Hans: 凸起的肚子可借圆顶形状来想象，也可被想象为身体容器或个人领域。

claim.en: Chinese expressions such as 手下 and the image 翻手为云，覆手为雨 associate hand imagery with subordination or control; this note is cultural-semantic, not etymological.
claim.zh-Hans: “手下”以及“翻手为云，覆手为雨”的意象把“手”与从属或支配相联；此处只作文化语义札记，不作词源解释。

summary.en: The proposed abdomen → dome → domain/control chain is retained as an authored association but rejected as a historical derivation. Similar spelling does not merge distinct etymological families.
summary.zh-Hans: 所提 abdomen → dome → domain／control 链作为作者联想保留，但作为历史派生关系不成立。拼写相似不能合并不同词源族。

claim.en: Segmenting abdomen as ab.dom.en and treating dom as the productive root is unsupported by the attested Latin form and its uncertain deeper origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 把 abdomen 切分为 ab.dom.en 并把 dom 当作能产词根，得不到已见拉丁语形式及其不确定深层来源的支持。

claim.en: Dome ‘rounded roof’, belly roundness, domain and control may form a literary-cognitive association, but the chain is not the historical source of the words.
claim.zh-Hans: dome“圆顶”、肚子的圆凸、domain 与 control 可构成文学—认知联想，但不是这些词的历史来源链。

claim.en: English abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ contains /d/ at the onset of its second syllable; Mandarin 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ begins with the pinyin d sound, phonetically an unaspirated [t].
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 的第二音节以 /d/ 起首；普通话“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 以拼音 d 所记的不送气 [t] 起首。

limitations.en: The stops share coronal place but differ in voicing and phonological system. /b m n/ and Mandarin tone are unmatched, so d-m or d-m-n cannot be claimed as a shared consonantal skeleton.
limitations.zh-Hans: 两者塞音同属冠音部位，但清浊及音系不同；/b m n/ 与普通话声调均无对应，因此不能宣称共享 d-m 或 d-m-n 辅音骨架。

relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 法语 abdomen 是拉丁学术借词；abdominal／abdominale 由它派生。

relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 仅因圆凸形状与拼写产生联想；并非由 abdomen 派生。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs to the ownership/master family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于所有权／主人词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs directly to the house/home family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 直接属于家屋／家庭词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于主人／统治词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于主人／统治词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

claim.zh-Hans: abdomen 与“肚”dù 可能通过冠音塞音及共享的 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 语义场形成有限的现代词形联想。

testability.zh-Hans: 用盲法评分分别检验声音相似与语义适配，并设置无关身体部位词和匹配的非身体词作为对照。

claim.zh-Hans: ROUND／CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL 可作为文学—认知链发挥作用，即使它不是历史词族派生链。

proposition.en: Is the belly our domain?
proposition.zh-Hans: 肚子是我们的领地吗？

text.en: Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the little dudou covering our bellies look like? We seem to have forgotten. In memory, a child's face is fresh and luminous, while the body still grows to nature's oldest rhythms. Girls, when nature gave you faces as gentle and radiant as moonlight, it also let life move with the waxing and waning moon. Boys, when nature gave you faces bright as sunlight, it also let life rise and fall with the sun. The abdomen may be imagined as an inner territory of the body, holding hunger, breath, growth, and our earliest memories.
text.zh-Hans: 肚子，是我们的领地吗？孩提时代，罩在腹部上的那方小小肚兜，究竟是什么模样？我们似乎早已忘了。记忆里的脸庞水灵清亮，身体还随着自然最古老的节律生长。女孩子们，大自然赠予你们月光般柔媚皎洁的面庞，也没有忘记让生命随着月亮的盈亏行走。男孩子们，大自然赠予你们阳光般明朗的面庞，也没有忘记让生命随着太阳的升落起伏。腹部像身体内部的一片领地，收藏着饥饿、呼吸、成长与最初的记忆。

editorial_notes.en: Standard translation and the experimental cross-language mapping are explicitly distinct: 腹部/腹 is formal, 肚子 is everyday, and isolated 肚 dù is the phonetic-semantic candidate.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 标准翻译与实验性跨语言 mapping 明确分开：“腹部／腹”为正式译法，“肚子”为日常对应，单字“肚”dù 才是语音—语义候选。

editorial_notes.en: The apparent dom spelling is not used to collapse abdomen, dome and the domus/dominus family into one root.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 不因表面共有 dom 拼写，就把 abdomen、dome 与 domus／dominus 词族合并为一个词根。

source.raw_note: 英语：abdomen ['æbdəmən] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.dom.en；abdominal [æb'dɔminəl] a. 腹；ab.dom.inal；domain n. 领地；dome n. 圆顶，肚子就是圆形的；domestic a. 领域内的；dominant a. 主导的；dominate v. 支配。法语：ab.dom.en [abdomen] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.domin.al,e [abdominal] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；abdominal (masculine)，abdominale (feminine)。汉语：肚【du】n. 肚子。备注：以上这些词汇大概都是由 dome 圆顶的根词演化而来的。也可以与肚 du 子的意思对应得上。主导等等词汇我们一般用手的词汇构成，例如手下，翻手为云覆手为雨。也许英语法语词汇用与肚子有关的词汇表达统治主导的意思。中文原文：肚子是我们的领地吗？当我们都是孩提时代，那在腹部上面的肚兜是啥模样？似乎都忘记想了。孩提时代的脸庞是水灵灵的。那女孩子们，大自然在给你们柔媚如月般的皎洁的时候。不忘记让你随着那月行走。那男孩子们，大自然在给你们阳光的面庞的时候，也没有忘记给你们随那太阳起落。用户英文原稿：Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the bellyband look like? I seem to have forgotten it. The face of a child is watery. Girls, when nature gave you the softness of the moon, it did not forget to let you walk with the moon. Boys, when nature gave you the sunny face, it also did not forget to let you rise and fall with the sun.

summary.en: Abdominal has four syllables and stress on /dɒm/ (UK) or /dɑː/ (US). 肚 dù is one syllable [tu˥˩]. English /d/ and Mandarin [t] share a coronal stop articulation but differ in voicing; /ɒ/ or /ɑː/ is not /u/, and /b m n l/, extra syllables and Mandarin tone have no full counterparts. Similarity is partial, not homophony.

title.en: ABERRANT ↔ 讹 é · 反常的／偏离常规的
title.zh-Hans: ABERRANT ↔ 讹 é · 反常的／偏离常规的

languages.name: Latin
languages.pronunciation: [ɛrˈraː.rɛ] approximate Classical reference; not recorded ancient speech

gloss.en: Departing from an accepted standard, normal course or natural type; atypical
gloss.zh-Hans: 偏离公认标准、正常路径或通常类型的；反常的、异常的

meaning.en: Standard adjective meaning: departing from the usual or normal type. Featured err ↔ 讹 é belongs to the related ERROR stage; modern semantic mapping → 偏; earlier Latin WANDER/STRAY mapping pending.
meaning.zh-Hans: 标准形容词义：反常的／偏离常规的。特色 err ↔ 讹 é 属于词族的 ERROR 阶段；现代语义映射 → 偏；早期拉丁 WANDER／STRAY 阶段待定。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Reviewed lexical equivalent

rationale.en: The standard adjective translation describes deviation from a norm. The featured err ↔ 讹 comparison is limited to the related ERROR stage, with separate evidence and confidence.
rationale.zh-Hans: 标准形容词翻译描述偏离常态；特色 err ↔ 讹 比较限定在相关 ERROR 阶段，证据与置信度独立。

summary.en: English aberrant comes from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, the present participle of aberrare: ab- ‘away, from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, be mistaken’. French aberrant/aberrante is the adjectivized present participle of French aberrer, itself borrowed from Latin aberrare; it is not evidenced here as an English loan. French erreur continues Latin error, erroris.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 来自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词：ab-“离开、从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”。法语 aberrant／aberrante 是法语 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词，而 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare；没有证据支持它从英语借入。法语 erreur 承自拉丁语 error、erroris。

claim.en: English aberrant is chiefly an adjective borrowed from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, present participle of aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 主要是形容词，借自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词。

claim.en: Latin aberrare is morphologically ab- ‘away/from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, err’; the b belongs to the inherited prefix ab-.
claim.zh-Hans: 拉丁语 aberrare 的形态是 ab-“离开／从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”；b 属于继承的前缀 ab-。

claim.en: French aberrant/aberrante is an adjectivized present participle of aberrer; French aberrer was borrowed from Latin aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 aberrant／aberrante 是 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词；法语 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare。

claim.en: English err is a verb from Middle English erren, borrowed from Anglo-French and Latin errare; French erreur is a feminine noun from Latin error, erroris.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 是动词，来自中古英语 erren，经盎格鲁-法语和拉丁语 errare；法语 erreur 是阴性名词，来自拉丁语 error、erroris。

summary.en: Featured ERR / ERROR ↔ 讹 é: error semantics overlap, but err is a verb; 讹 is selected in error/corruption uses. BrE non-rhotic /ɜː/, rhotic /er, ɝ/ and Mandarin /ɤ˧˥/ differ. Modern stage → 偏; Latin wander/stray stage mapping pending.
summary.zh-Hans: 特色 ERR / ERROR ↔ 讹 é：错误义有交集，但 err 为动词，讹取差错／讹误用法。非 rhotic 英式 /ɜː/、rhotic /er, ɝ/ 与普通话 /ɤ˧˥/ 不同。现代阶段 → 偏；拉丁游走／迷途阶段 Mapping pending。

claim.en: Featured 讹 é compares the ERR / ERROR family error sense, using modern English err for the sound test. It is not a translation of the whole adjective aberrant or a reconstruction of Latin pronunciation. Historical Relation: Not claimed.
claim.zh-Hans: 特色讹 é 对应 ERR / ERROR 词族的错误义阶段，声音检验采用现代英语 err。它不是整个形容词 aberrant 的标准翻译，也不是拉丁古音重构。Historical Relation: Not claimed。

summary.en: Modern ABERRANT → 偏 is a semantic abstraction. Latin WANDER / STRAY and figurative ERROR coexist in the recorded family: the path is a semantic organization, not a dated sequence in which each sense replaced the previous one.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代 ABERRANT → 偏 是语义概括。拉丁词族已有游走／偏离及比喻错误义并存；此路径为语义组织，不是每义依次取代前义的精确年代链。

summary.en: The proposed idea that b was inserted merely to connect initial a to err is rejected as a historical explanation: b is part of Latin ab-. The observation is preserved as an author sound-structure hypothesis, not deleted.
summary.zh-Hans: “b 只是为连接开头 a 与 err 而加入”的想法，作为历史解释被否定：b 属于拉丁前缀 ab-。这一观察仍作为作者的声音结构假说保留，而非删除。

claim.en: Author hypothesis: b may have been inserted between a and err as a consonantal bridge.
claim.zh-Hans: 作者假说：b 可能作为辅音桥梁插入 a 与 err 之间。

claim.en: err ↔ 讹 is an accent-dependent partial resemblance, not homophony.
claim.zh-Hans: err ↔ 讹 为受口音影响的部分音近，不是同音。

phonetic_observation.scope: Modern English sound comparison within a historically identified family; no Latin–Old Chinese sound equation

onset.en: Both are phonologically vowel-initial. Absence of an onset is common and not positive evidence of a consonant correspondence.
onset.zh-Hans: 均可分析为零声母／元音起首；无声母很常见，不是辅音规律对应的正证。

vowel.en: BrE /ɜː/ is a long central vowel; AmE /er/ has a front vowel and /r/, or /ɝ/ has rhotic colouring. Mandarin /ɤ/ is back and unrounded; spelling e does not equate these vowels.
vowel.zh-Hans: 英式 /ɜː/ 为长央元音；美式 /er/ 为前元音加 /r/，另有卷舌 /ɝ/。普通话 /ɤ/ 为后不圆唇元音；字母 e 相似不等于元音相同。

rhoticity.en: Non-rhotic BrE err has no final /r/ before a pause, but may link /r/ before a vowel; rhotic accents retain /r/ or r-colouring. Mandarin é has neither.
rhoticity.zh-Hans: 非 rhotic 英式 err 在停顿前无词尾 /r/，元音前可连读 /r/；rhotic 口音保留 /r/ 或卷舌色彩；普通话 é 均无。

syllables.en: err and é are monosyllabic. error is two syllables /ˈerə(r), ˈerər/; erreur /ɛ.ʁœʁ/ is two syllables with uvular rhotics and a rounded /œ/. Neither is a homophone of é; whole aberrant has three syllables.
syllables.zh-Hans: err、é 均单音节；error /ˈerə(r), ˈerər/ 为两音节；erreur /ɛ.ʁœʁ/ 为两音节，含小舌音及圆唇 /œ/。两者均非 é 的同音词；完整 aberrant 为三音节。

tone.en: Mandarin é has lexical rising tone /ɤ˧˥/; English stress and French phrase prosody do not match Mandarin tone.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话 é 带阳平 /ɤ˧˥/；英语重音、法语短语韵律不对应普通话词汇声调。

rating.method: Editorial components: onset absence 1/10; vowel resemblance 4/8; rhotic/coda fit across accents 2/5; one-syllable shape 3/4; tone/prosody 0/3. No acoustic data. The whole error/erreur words receive no transferred err score.

limitations.en: Featured 讹 é compares the ERR / ERROR family error sense, using modern English err for the sound test. It is not a translation of the whole adjective aberrant or a reconstruction of Latin pronunciation. Historical Relation: Not claimed.
limitations.zh-Hans: 特色讹 é 对应 ERR / ERROR 词族的错误义阶段，声音检验采用现代英语 err。它不是整个形容词 aberrant 的标准翻译，也不是拉丁古音重构。Historical Relation: Not claimed。

claim.en: English err and Mandarin 讹 é may form a memorable modern sound-meaning association in the ERROR/DEVIATION field, without common-origin claim.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 与普通话“讹”é 可能在 ERROR／DEVIATION 语义场形成可记忆的现代声音—意义联想，但不主张共同来源。

one LATIN-ERRARE family, not independent English/French samples
counterexamples: vowel quality differs
non-rhotic and rhotic English vary
Mandarin tone unmatched
verb versus nominal/compound usage
no demonstrated cross-language historical chain

testability.en: Test blinded sound-similarity and semantic-relatedness separately, with unrelated onsetless-vowel controls and multiple English accents.
testability.zh-Hans: 分别盲测声音相似度与语义相关度，加入无关零声母元音负对照，并覆盖多种英语口音。

claim.en: The b in aberrant was added as a consonantal bridge between a and err.
claim.zh-Hans: aberrant 中的 b 是在 a 与 err 之间加入的辅音桥。

supporting_cases: surface segmentation a.b.err.ant in the author note
counterexamples: documented Latin aberrant-, aberrans
documented morpheme ab- + errare
French aberrer independently continues Latin aberrare

testability.en: Historical morphology is already testable against attested Latin forms and dictionary etymologies; those sources contradict the insertion account.
testability.zh-Hans: 历史形态可直接用有文献的拉丁语形式与词源词典检验；这些来源与插入说相矛盾。

proposition.en: In a moment of error, is it beauty like a swan’s, or a goose’s mistaken call? No, that love is full of beauty and art.
proposition.zh-Hans: 错讹的时候，是一种如天鹅般美丽还是家鹅的讹音？不，那爱充满美艺。

translations.text: In a moment of error, is it beauty like a swan’s, or a goose’s mistaken call? No, that love is full of beauty and art.

evidence_boundary.en: The swan/domestic-goose, mis-sound, love, beauty and art wordplay is literature. It does not support the historical morphology or the err ↔ 讹 hypothesis.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 天鹅／家鹅、讹音、爱、美与艺的文字游戏属于文学，不为历史形态或 err ↔ 讹假说提供证据。

rationale.en: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ historical etymology. 闭 can mean close or stop, but does not inherently encode temporary suspension. The compared bey /beɪ/ is a modern stressed syllable, not a verified historical root. No homophony or historical relationship with Chinese is claimed.

summary.en: English abeyance was borrowed from Anglo-French abeyaunce, a succession/ownership term, from abaer/abair plus -ance. The verb contains a- from Latin ad- and baer/baier (gape); MW traces the latter to reconstructed Vulgar Latin *batāre, possibly imitative. This a- is not negative. The historical open/gape image is different from the proposed Chinese close image.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 abeyance 借自盎格鲁法语 abeyaunce（继承／权属悬置用语），来自 abaer／abair 加 -ance；动词中的 a- 源于拉丁 ad-，baer／baier 指张口。MW 将后者追至重构通俗拉丁语 *batāre，拟声来源仅为可能。这里的 a- 不是否定；历史上的张开意象不同于候选“闭”的关闭意象。

summary.en: Abeyance /əˈbeɪ.əns/ has three syllables and second-syllable stress. Compare only /beɪ/ with 闭 bì [pi˥˧] as transcribed by ZDIC: /b/ and [p] share bilabial stop place/manner but differ in voicing; /eɪ/ is a diphthong, [i] a monophthong. Mandarin fourth tone is lexical; English stress is not that tone. The full word adds /ə/ and /əns/. Partial surface similarity is not homophony.

summary.en: ACTIVE → TEMPORARILY INACTIVE ↔ OPEN → CLOSED is an interpretive model. The Chinese stop/end sense supplies a partial semantic overlap, but temporary duration and possible resumption must come from context. Closed worries in green rain are the author’s literary transformation, not a dictionary example of abeyance.

claim.en: Abeyance /əˈbeɪ.əns/ has three syllables and second-syllable stress. Compare only /beɪ/ with 闭 bì [pi˥˧] as transcribed by ZDIC: /b/ and [p] share bilabial stop place/manner but differ in voicing; /eɪ/ is a diphthong, [i] a monophthong. Mandarin fourth tone is lexical; English stress is not that tone. The full word adds /ə/ and /əns/. Partial surface similarity is not homophony.
claim.zh-Hans: abeyance /əˈbeɪ.əns/ 为三音节，第二音节重读。只比较 /beɪ/ 与汉典所标闭 bì [pi˥˧]：/b/ 与 [p] 同为双唇塞音，但清浊不同；/eɪ/ 是双元音，[i] 是单元音。普通话去声是词汇声调，英语重音并不等于该声调；整词另有 /ə/ 与 /əns/。只属局部表面音近，不是同音。

title.en: ABHOR ↔ 火 huǒ · 憎恶 / 厌恶
title.zh-Hans: ABHOR ↔ 火 huǒ · 憎恶 / 厌恶

gloss.en: Featured candidate: -hor ↔ 火 huǒ; standard translation 憎恶 / 厌恶
gloss.zh-Hans: 特色候选：-hor ↔ 火 huǒ；标准翻译 憎恶 / 厌恶

meaning.en: Featured Phonetic-Semantic / Dialectal-Affective Candidate. Author-attested negative attitude and an indirect FIRE/HEAT → strong negative affect bridge. Direct lexical-semantic equivalence: No. Independent evidence pending. Standard Translation: 憎恶 / 厌恶. Modern Standard Semantic Mapping: ABHOR → 恶 wù (Supported / A). Diachronic Semantic Mapping: HORRĒRE → 骇 hài (Candidate / C). Historical Relation: Not claimed.
meaning.zh-Hans: Featured Phonetic-Semantic / Dialectal-Affective Candidate。作者方言观察报告不满、反感、厌恶，结合 FIRE/HEAT → 强烈负面情绪的间接认知桥梁。Direct lexical-semantic equivalence: No。Independent evidence pending。 Standard Translation：憎恶 / 厌恶。现代标准语义：ABHOR → 恶 wù（Supported / A）。历时映射：HORRĒRE → 骇 hài（Candidate / C）。Historical Relation: Not claimed。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Featured Phonetic-Semantic / Dialectal-Affective Candidate

rationale.en: Selected per entry for limited stressed -hor/huǒ resemblance and author-attested dialectal affect, not standard lexical equivalence or historical cognacy. ANGER ≠ AVERSION/DETESTATION.
rationale.zh-Hans: 按本词选择：重读 -hor 与 huǒ 的有限音近、作者方言情绪用例及认知桥梁；不是标准词汇等值或历史同源。ANGER ≠ AVERSION/DETESTATION。

summary.en: Middle English abhorren borrowed Latin abhorrēre: ab- (away/from) + horrēre (bristle, shudder, tremble). Recoil and repugnance motivate aversion/detest. French abhorrer is independently a Latin borrowing.
summary.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abhorren 借自拉丁语 abhorrēre：ab- 表离开／自，horrēre 表毛发竖起、战栗、颤抖；退缩、排斥与憎恶相联系。法语 abhorrer 独立记录为拉丁借词。

claim.en: Middle English abhorren borrowed Latin abhorrēre: ab- (away/from) + horrēre (bristle, shudder, tremble). Recoil and repugnance motivate aversion/detest. French abhorrer is independently a Latin borrowing.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abhorren 借自拉丁语 abhorrēre：ab- 表离开／自，horrēre 表毛发竖起、战栗、颤抖；退缩、排斥与憎恶相联系。法语 abhorrer 独立记录为拉丁借词。

summary.en: Compare only modern English -hor /hɔː(r)/ with Mandarin 火 [xwo˨˩˦]. Limited resemblance, not homophony or a demonstrated correspondence.
summary.zh-Hans: 仅比较现代英语 -hor /hɔː(r)/ 与普通话火 [xwo˨˩˦]：有限音近，不是同音，也不是已经证实的规律对应。

claim.en: Modern abhor versus 恶 wù: weak whole-word resemblance, not homophony.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代 abhor 对恶 wù：整词音近弱，不是同音。

claim.en: Compare only modern English -hor /hɔː(r)/ with Mandarin 火 [xwo˨˩˦]. Limited resemblance, not homophony or a demonstrated correspondence.
claim.zh-Hans: 仅比较现代英语 -hor /hɔː(r)/ 与普通话火 [xwo˨˩˦]：有限音近，不是同音，也不是已经证实的规律对应。

summary.en: The Latin reaction-to-aversion pathway supports stage comparison with 骇. The separate 火 candidate now includes author-attested dialect usage, while independent lexical evidence remains limited to anger/displeasure and the endpoints remain unequal.
summary.zh-Hans: 拉丁身体反应至厌恶的路径支持与骇作阶段比较；火候选现包含作者方言用例，独立词汇证据仍限于愤怒／不满，终点不等同。

claim.en: Physical bristling/shudder/recoil → horror/aversion → detest: a lexicographically motivated conceptual summary, not a dated linear chain.
claim.zh-Hans: 身体竖毛／战栗／退缩 → 恐惧／厌恶 → 憎恶：据辞书整理的概念路径，不是逐年代的线性词史。

claim.en: Physical fire/heat → anger; broader intense affect is interpretive. Modern lexical senses do not by themselves establish historical order.
claim.zh-Hans: 实体火／热 → 愤怒；推广至强烈情绪属于解释。现代义项共存本身不能证明历时先后。

claim.en: Two independent paths share a partial embodied/intense-negative-affect structure, with different endpoints: aversion/detest versus anger.
claim.zh-Hans: 两条独立路径部分共享具身／强烈负面情绪结构；终点分别为厌恶／憎恶与愤怒，并不相同。

claim.en: Semantic-stage comparison, not cross-language common descent or a dated linear chronology. 骇 compares fright/startle with the embodied reaction stage; it is not a literal equivalent of every BRISTLE/SHUDDER/TREMBLE sense or a direct modern translation of abhor. Modern Mandarin readings are not ancient Chinese reconstructions.
claim.zh-Hans: 这是 semantic-stage comparison，不是跨语言共同词源或逐年代的线性词史。骇以惊惧／受惊义比较早期身体反应阶段，不等同于 BRISTLE/SHUDDER/TREMBLE 的每个字面义，也不是现代 abhor 的直接译词。普通话读音不是古汉语拟音。

summary.en: No above-chance phonetic-affective association or historical relation has been demonstrated.
summary.zh-Hans: 尚未证明超出偶然的音义关联或历史关系。

claim.en: Modern abhor versus 恶 wù: weak whole-word resemblance, not homophony.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代 abhor 对恶 wù：整词音近弱，不是同音。

onset.en: English begins /əb-/ with /b/ before stressed /h/; Mandarin wù has zero consonantal initial, with possible phonetic [w] onset. Pinyin w is not English /h/.
onset.zh-Hans: 英语以 /əb-/ 起始，重读音节前有 /h/；普通话 wù 为零声母，可带语音性 [w] 起始。拼音 w 不对应 /h/。

vowel.en: English /ə, ɔː/ versus Mandarin /u/: different height and quality; broad rounding alone is weak.
vowel.zh-Hans: 英语 /ə, ɔː/ 对普通话 /u/，高度、音质不同，宽泛圆唇性不足以构成强对应。

syllables.en: Two English syllables versus one Mandarin syllable; /b/ and /h/ lack matches.
syllables.zh-Hans: 英语两音节对普通话一音节；/b/、/h/ 无对应。

rhoticity.en: US /r/ adds a mismatch; reference non-rhotic UK isolation lacks final r.
rhoticity.zh-Hans: 美音 /r/ 增加差异；参考非卷舌英音单念无词尾 r。

tone.en: Mandarin fourth tone has no English lexical-tone equivalent.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话去声没有英语词汇声调对应。

rating.method: Provisional unvalidated editorial feature comparison; not acoustic measurements or blinded ratings

claim.en: Compare only modern English -hor /hɔː(r)/ with Mandarin 火 [xwo˨˩˦]. Limited resemblance, not homophony or a demonstrated correspondence.
claim.zh-Hans: 仅比较现代英语 -hor /hɔː(r)/ 与普通话火 [xwo˨˩˦]：有限音近，不是同音，也不是已经证实的规律对应。

onset.en: English /h/ is glottal; Mandarin /x/ is velar. Both are voiceless fricative-like sounds, not identical places of articulation.
onset.zh-Hans: 英语 /h/ 为声门音，普通话 /x/ 为软腭擦音；同有清擦音性质，但发音部位不相同。

glide.en: Mandarin has /w/ (often transcribed as nonsyllabic u); English target has no corresponding glide.
glide.zh-Hans: 普通话有 /w/ 介音（亦以非音节 u 转写）；英语目标段无对应介音。

vowel.en: English /ɔː/ versus Mandarin /o/ after /w/: a broad rounded back-vowel resemblance; quality, duration and movement differ.
vowel.zh-Hans: 英语 /ɔː/ 与普通话 /w/ 后的 /o/ 仅有宽泛圆唇后元音近似；音质、时长与运动不同。

rhoticity.en: Reference non-rhotic British speech lacks final r in isolation; linking r can occur before a vowel. Reference US speech retains /r/, commonly [ɹ].
rhoticity.zh-Hans: 参考非卷舌英音单念无词尾 r，后接元音可出现连接 r；参考美音保留 /r/，常实现为 [ɹ]。

coda.en: British isolated target has no coda; US target has rhoticity/final r. Mandarin 火 has no consonantal coda.
coda.zh-Hans: 英音单念目标段无韵尾；美音有 r／卷舌性；普通话火无辅音韵尾。

tone.en: Mandarin third tone, citation 214, has no English lexical-tone match; connected-speech realization varies.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话上声单念常记214，英语无相应词汇声调；连读实际调值会变化。

whole_word.en: English /əb-/ is excluded from the selected target; whole-word resemblance is weaker. Modern -hor must not be projected onto Latin horrēre.
whole_word.zh-Hans: 所选片段排除了英语 /əb-/，整词相似更弱；不能把现代 -hor 的音值倒投为拉丁 horrēre 的读音。

limitations.en: Abhor means detest or loathe; 火 means fire and has conventional anger uses. Direct lexical-semantic equivalence: No. ANGER ≠ AVERSION/DETESTATION; this is an indirect affective/cognitive bridge.
limitations.zh-Hans: abhor 的标准译义是憎恶／厌恶；火的基本义是实体火，并有常规发怒用法。Direct lexical-semantic equivalence: No。ANGER ≠ AVERSION/DETESTATION；本条只提出间接情绪／认知桥梁。

rating.method: Provisional unvalidated editorial feature comparison; not acoustic measurements or blinded ratings

secondary_french.en: French /abɔʁe/: the letters h and rr do not supply English /h/ plus /r/; /ɔʁ/ versus /xwo/ is a weaker secondary comparison. No extra independent cognacy evidence.
secondary_french.zh-Hans: 法语 /abɔʁe/：书写 h 不发 /h/，rr 不等于英语 /h/ 加 /r/；/ɔʁ/ 对 /xwo/ 是更弱的次级比较，不增加独立同源证据。

semantic_structure.relation: HORRĒRE — BRISTLE / SHUDDER / TREMBLE ↔ 骇 → RECOIL / AVERSION → ABHOR — DETEST / LOATHE ↔ 恶

statement.en: ANGER ≠ AVERSION/DETESTATION; one can detest calmly or be angry without detesting.
