editorial_notes.en: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ Diachronic Mapping. Modern standard semantics is recorded separately; each object has independent evidence and confidence.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 标准翻译 ≠ 特色映射 ≠ 历时映射。现代标准语义单独记录，各对象独立标注证据与置信度。

editorial_notes.en: Stable ID, 40-record dataset and Published entry status retained. Featured 火 remains Candidate / D / Low; Supported / A belongs only to modern 恶 wù.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 保留 ID、40条数据集及 Published 状态。Featured 火保持 Candidate / D / Low；Supported / A 只属于现代恶 wù。

editorial_notes.en: A — Direct grades only the documented selected lexical sense, consistent with the framework’s Direct category. Semantic confidence High within digital-source scope; overall confidence Medium because sound correspondence is weak and print-entry audit remains pending. No cognacy or experimental promotion.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: A—Direct 仅评价有辞书支持的所选词义直接对应，不代表声音强。数字来源范围内语义置信度 High；声音弱、纸本条目待核，综合置信度 Medium。不升级同源或实验结论。

editorial_notes.en: Semantic-stage comparison, not cross-language common descent or a dated linear chronology. 骇 compares fright/startle with the embodied reaction stage; it is not a literal equivalent of every BRISTLE/SHUDDER/TREMBLE sense or a direct modern translation of abhor. Modern Mandarin readings are not ancient Chinese reconstructions.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 这是 semantic-stage comparison，不是跨语言共同词源或逐年代的线性词史。骇以惊惧／受惊义比较早期身体反应阶段，不等同于 BRISTLE/SHUDDER/TREMBLE 的每个字面义，也不是现代 abhor 的直接译词。普通话读音不是古汉语拟音。

editorial_notes.en: Featured Mapping is selected per entry and may differ from Standard Translation; selection must state whether its strength is phonetic, semantic, cognitive, dialectal, or cultural.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: Featured Mapping 按每个词具体选择，可以不同于标准翻译；须注明优势属于语音、语义、认知、方言或文化，并分别标明证据类型和置信度。

claim.en: Physical bristling/shudder/recoil → horror/aversion → detest: a lexicographically motivated conceptual summary, not a dated linear chain.
claim.zh-Hans: 身体竖毛／战栗／退缩 → 恐惧／厌恶 → 憎恶：据辞书整理的概念路径，不是逐年代的线性词史。

claim.en: Physical fire/heat → anger; broader intense affect is interpretive. Modern lexical senses do not by themselves establish historical order.
claim.zh-Hans: 实体火／热 → 愤怒；推广至强烈情绪属于解释。现代义项共存本身不能证明历时先后。

comparison.en: Two independent paths share a partial embodied/intense-negative-affect structure, with different endpoints: aversion/detest versus anger.
comparison.zh-Hans: 两条独立路径部分共享具身／强烈负面情绪结构；终点分别为厌恶／憎恶与愤怒，并不相同。

experiment_plan.design: Separate phonetic and semantic judgments; hide author note and spelling from auditory raters; British non-rhotic and American rhotic strata; randomize matched syllable/frequency controls; horizontal and horse as etymological negative controls only, not matched statistical controls; deduplicate HORR family; preregister outcomes, sample size and analysis before collection.
experiment_plan.falsification: No held-out advantage over matched random pairs, or disappearance after controlling generic negative valence; no upgrade from software tests.
experiment_plan.scope: Separate sound hypotheses; supported standard translation and modern lexical equivalence do not depend on this experiment

proposition.en: Look toward the distant horizon.
proposition.zh-Hans: 看远方的地平线。

text.en: Winter colours are in fashion. A few simple colours feel bright, light and quietly beautiful. Looking far away on the first day of spring, I imagine flowers emerging and waiting to bloom. The distance to the horizon is not so far after all.
text.zh-Hans:
冬天的颜色，正是现在的流行色。简单的几种颜色搭配在一起，显得明亮、轻快、靓丽而静洁。

目光投向极远处。花朵正在悄悄顶出泥土。立春日，沿着地平线走一趟，看看远方的地平线。那里已经有鲜花等待盛开。

到地平线的距离，其实并不远。

meaning.en: A large hoofed mammal used for riding or drawing loads. Standard translation: 马 mǎ (Supported). The cultural chain 马 → 午 → 火 is separately Candidate / D.

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Standard lexical translation

rationale.en: horse → 马 is lexical translation. 马 → 午 uses the conventional branch–animal pairing; 午 → 火 uses a separate five-phase classification. Combining these as a FIRE association is a symbolic mapping, not a definition or etymology.

summary.en: Middle English hors continues Old English hors; Merriam-Webster compares Old High German hros. Etymonline gives reconstructed Proto-Germanic *harss-, with deeper origin unknown. semantic_structure.relation: 马 → 午马 → 午 / 火 → FIRE association

claim.en: horse → 马 is lexical translation. 马 → 午 uses the conventional branch–animal pairing; 午 → 火 uses a separate five-phase classification. Combining these as a FIRE association is a symbolic mapping, not a definition or etymology.
claim.zh-Hans: horse → 马是标准翻译。马 → 午依据通行地支配禽／生肖配属；午 → 火依据另一套五行配属。两套分类相关但不相同，组合后形成 FIRE association，不是词义定义或历史词源。

supporting_cases: Independently sourced Chinese classification links; not independent cross-language replication
counterexamples: horse 的英语历史词源独立，hor- 的拼写不能作为火的历史词根。
马 mǎ 的标准动物义是 horse，不是火；文化链不改变标准翻译。
午配马与午属火来自不同但关联的传统分类系统，不是马字或英语 horse 的造词过程。
《论衡》所记十二辰配禽不能自动证明完整的生年生肖制度；早期配属有异文与历史层次。
王充引述配属后反驳用五行相克解释动物制胜；传统分类不是自然因果证明。
文化映射不能证明跨语言同源，也不增加声音分数；片段挑选与偶然音近仍是替代解释。
ABHOR、HORIZON、HORSE 三种作者路径不能互证 hor = 火。

testability.en: Preregister separate sound-only UK/US vs Mandarin ratings and translation/memory tasks with and without the cultural chain. Use matched random pairs, other animal–branch examples and unrelated-family controls; deduplicate families. Fix sample size and outcomes before collection. Failure to beat matched baselines counts against a sound or learning benefit.
testability.zh-Hans: 预注册英美／普通话纯听觉评分，并另做有／无文化提示的翻译与记忆任务；使用匹配随机词对、其他动物地支例和异词族对照，真实词族去重。采集前固定样本量和指标；不优于匹配基线即不支持声音或学习收益。

title.zh-Hans: 南迦巴瓦峰｜专名／文学词条

languages.name: Tibetan
languages.pronunciation: Wylie: gnam lcags ’bar ba; Tibetan pinyin: Namjagbarwa

languages.name: English / Romanized form
languages.pronunciation: name form; pronunciation not independently normalized

gloss.en: A proper name for the 7,782-metre mountain in Nyingchi, Tibet Autonomous Region, at the eastern end of the Himalayas.
gloss.zh-Hans: 西藏自治区林芝市境内、喜马拉雅山脉东端一座海拔 7782 米山峰的专名。

meaning.en: Named-entity correspondence, not an ordinary lexical translation. Tibetan གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ། (gnam lcags ’bar ba) can be read lexically as ‘blazing sky-iron / meteorite’ or, with gnam lcags understood as lightning, ‘blazing lightning.’ The Chinese 南迦巴瓦 is a sound-based transcription, not a semantic translation.
meaning.zh-Hans: 这是专名形式对应，不是普通词汇翻译。藏文 གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།（gnam lcags ’bar ba）按词面可理解为“燃烧／闪耀的天铁（陨铁）”，若把 gnam lcags 取“雷电／霹雳”义，则可理解为“燃烧／闪耀的雷电”。汉语“南迦巴瓦”属于音译，不是意译。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Named-entity name-form correspondence

rationale.en: The Romanized and Chinese forms identify the same place. Name-meaning reports are kept as separate, attributed evidence items and are not converted into a phonetic-semantic candidate.
rationale.zh-Hans: 罗马字母形式与汉字形式指向同一地点。名称释义按来源拆分为独立证据项，不转化为语音—语义候选。

orthography_note.en: Tibet Daily's Tibetan-language site, the Rangjung Yeshe place entry and Kyoto University's academic Tibet map use gnam without a final s. Some secondary web sources print གནམས / gnams; this entry adopts the better-attested གནམ / gnam form and records the variant without treating it as primary.
orthography_note.zh-Hans: 西藏日报藏文网站、Rangjung Yeshe 地名条目及京都大学学术地图均采用不带词尾 s 的 གནམ / gnam。部分二手网页写作 གནམས / gnams；本条采用证据更充分的 གནམ / gnam，同时记录该异写，不将其作为主写法。

meaning.en: sky, heaven, atmosphere
meaning.zh-Hans: 天空、天、苍穹

meaning.en: iron, metal
meaning.zh-Hans: 铁、金属

meaning.en: sky-iron / meteoric iron; also thunderbolt or lightning
meaning.zh-Hans: 天铁／陨铁；亦可指霹雳、雷电

meaning.en: to blaze, burn, shine or glow
meaning.zh-Hans: 燃烧、闪耀、发光

assessment.en: 南迦巴瓦 approximately follows the sound sequence Nam-jag-bar-wa; 峰 adds the Chinese geographic classifier ‘peak.’ The individual Chinese character meanings are not a translation of the Tibetan morphemes.
assessment.zh-Hans: “南迦巴瓦”大体按 Nam-jag-bar-wa 的音节转写，“峰”补出汉语地理类别。南、迦、巴、瓦各字的汉语字义不用于翻译藏文词素。

analysis.en: Closest among the published Chinese explanations when gnam lcags is read as lightning and ’bar ba as blazing/burning. ‘如火’ is explanatory rather than a separate Tibetan morpheme.
analysis.zh-Hans: 在公开汉语解释中最接近藏文结构：gnam lcags 可取“雷电”，’bar ba 可取“燃烧／闪耀”。其中“如火”是汉语说明性补充，并非另有一个对应藏文词素。

analysis.en: A direct compositional rendering of gnam ‘sky’ + lcags ‘iron/metal’ + ’bar ba ‘blaze/burn/shine.’ Princeton's Dictionary of Buddhism similarly gives ‘Blazing Meteor.’
analysis.zh-Hans: 按 gnam“天”＋lcags“铁／金属”＋’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”组合出的较直接译法。《普林斯顿佛教辞典》亦将整词释作“Blazing Meteor（燃烧的流星／陨星）”。

translation_assessments.chinese: 直刺蓝天的战矛／直刺天空的长矛

analysis.en: The Tibetan written form contains no separately identifiable morpheme for spear, battle or piercing. This is best labelled an image associated with the mountain's shape and the Gesar epic tradition, not a literal translation.
analysis.zh-Hans: 藏文词面中没有可分别对应“长矛／战矛”“刺入”的词素。较合理的身份是结合山形与《格萨尔王传》传统形成的形象化文化解释，而非直译。

analysis.en: It reflects the ‘sky-iron / meteorite’ sense of gnam lcags, but changes iron/metal to stone and omits ’bar ba ‘blazing.’
analysis.zh-Hans: 它抓住了 gnam lcags“天铁／陨铁”的来源意象，但把“铁／金属”泛化为“石头”，并省略了 ’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”。

analysis.en: An attested honorific epithet. The written name contains no morpheme meaning mountain, many/all, or father, so it is not a translation of the name.
analysis.zh-Hans: 这是有资料记录的尊称。藏文名称中没有“山”“众”“父”对应词素，因此不是山名字面翻译。

summary.en: Authoritative and institutional sources agree on the place identity and commonly report 7,782 metres, but published explanations of the Tibetan name vary and do not establish one exclusive etymology here.
summary.zh-Hans: 权威及机构来源对地点身份一致，并普遍采用海拔 7782 米；但公开资料对藏语名称的解释不一，本词条不据此确立唯一词源。

claim.en: Tibetan-language and academic geographic sources record the name as གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།, Wylie gnam lcags ’bar ba.
claim.zh-Hans: 藏文媒体与学术地名资料将名称写作 གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།，威利转写为 gnam lcags ’bar ba。

claim.en: Dictionary evidence supports gnam ‘sky,’ gnam lcags ‘meteoric iron / thunderbolt / lightning,’ and ’bar ba ‘blaze, burn, shine,’ making ‘blazing sky-iron / meteor’ or ‘blazing lightning’ the closest lexical analyses.
claim.zh-Hans: 词典证据支持 gnam“天空”、gnam lcags“陨铁／霹雳／雷电”、’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”，因此“燃烧的天铁／陨星”或“燃烧的雷电”是更贴近词面的分析。

claim.en: A Tibet Autonomous Region government page reports the name as meaning ‘a battle spear piercing the blue sky.’
claim.zh-Hans: 西藏自治区人民政府页面将名称释为“直刺蓝天的战矛”。

claim.en: China Tibet Online reports multiple explanations: ‘lightning burning like fire’ and ‘a long spear piercing the sky’; it connects the latter image with the ‘Battle of Menling’ in the Epic of King Gesar.
claim.zh-Hans: 中国西藏网明确称其藏语有多种解释：一为“雷电如火燃烧”，一为“直刺天空的长矛”；后者与《格萨尔王传》“门岭一战”的长矛意象相连。

claim.en: The Nyingchi municipal government identifies Namcha Barwa as a 7,782-metre mountain at the eastern end of the Himalayas and the highest mountain in Nyingchi.
claim.zh-Hans: 林芝市人民政府资料记载：南迦巴瓦峰海拔 7782 米，位于喜马拉雅山脉东端，是林芝市最高山峰。

claim.en: A Chinese Academy of Sciences science-communication article records ‘father of mountains’ as a Tibetan epithet alongside the spear-like image; it is treated as an epithet, not a literal decomposition of the name.
claim.zh-Hans: 中国科学院科普文章在“刺向苍穹的利矛”意象之外，记录其藏语称谓“众山之父”；本词条将其视为称谓，不作为名称字面拆解。

summary.en: This entry records forms of one proper name; it makes no cross-language phonetic-semantic candidate claim.
summary.zh-Hans: 本词条记录同一专名的不同形式，不提出跨语言语音—语义候选。

summary.en: Cloud veil, youthful face, forest, lake and song are literary images created by the author around the named place.
summary.zh-Hans: 云的面纱、青春容颜、森林、湖与歌声是作者围绕该地点专名展开的文学意象。

summary.en: No new etymological, phonetic or historical-origin hypothesis is proposed.
summary.zh-Hans: 不提出新的词源、语音或历史起源假说。

proposition.zh-Hans: 南迦巴瓦，愿你保留你的容颜。
proposition.fr: Namcha Barwa, que ton visage demeure.

text.zh-Hans: 在花园里，水仙、迎春、春兰、杜鹃花、牡丹、月季，她们同时在春天盛开。和风吹在我的花园内，吹动着花的香气。

title.en: Namcha Barwa, May Your Countenance Endure
title.zh-Hans: 南迦巴瓦，愿你保留你的容颜
title.fr: Namcha Barwa, que ton visage demeure

text.zh-Hans:
看过南迦巴瓦山的一些照片，很喜欢西藏这个藏在漫漫群山中的秀丽山峰。

南迦巴瓦山啊，
你是我的心里的少男少女，
是我自己心里的透出熏香味的向往，
还是我自己那少年时代的持续？
那美丽是就像我看到那青春的照片，
那是少年时代的情绪的青涩，
那不正是你的青春似的树🌳与湖吗？
有愿望的我想保持一颗爱你的心💕，
因为我的爱你的光芒，
将使你的青春的面容总是清秀。

你轻柔的云的面纱，
你貌似的对我发出尊重的话语，
可是我却总是希望撕下，
你的优雅的话语所包围的遮幕，
总是想看到你的真容，
在走进你心底的森林的深处，
我却晓得了你的柔美的如丽水般，
流淌的心如歌声的，
在与你温煦话语的对话，
与你激烈的对抗中，
我却对你产生了从我的心底，
流出的一种爱意。
text.en:
After seeing photographs of Namcha Barwa, I came to love this beautiful Tibetan peak hidden among range upon range of mountains.

O Namcha Barwa,
you are the young men and women within my heart,
the longing in me that breathes the fragrance of incense,
or perhaps the continuation of my own youth.
That beauty is like a photograph of youth before my eyes,
the tender greenness of a young heart—
are those not your youthful trees 🌳 and lake?
I long to keep a heart that loves you 💕,
for the radiance of my love for you
will keep your youthful countenance forever clear.

Your tender veil of cloud,
the reverent words you seem to speak to me—
and yet I am always longing to tear away
the curtain woven around you by your graceful speech,
always longing to behold your true face.
Deep in the forest where I enter your innermost heart,
I come to know your gentleness, lovely as clear water,
your flowing heart, like a song.
In our dialogue of warm words,
in our fierce confrontation,
there rises in me, from the bottom of my heart,
a current of love for you.
text.fr:
Après avoir vu quelques photographies du Namcha Barwa, j’ai aimé ce beau sommet du Tibet, caché au milieu de chaînes de montagnes sans fin.

Ô Namcha Barwa,
tu es les jeunes hommes et les jeunes femmes au fond de mon cœur,
le désir qui, en moi, exhale un parfum d’encens,
ou peut-être la continuité de ma propre jeunesse.
Ta beauté ressemble à une photographie de la jeunesse sous mes yeux,
à la tendre verdeur des émotions adolescentes —
ne sont-ce pas là tes arbres 🌳 et ton lac, pareils à la jeunesse ?
Je désire garder un cœur qui t’aime 💕,
car la lumière de mon amour pour toi
gardera toujours limpide ton visage de jeunesse.

Ton léger voile de nuages,
les paroles respectueuses que tu sembles m’adresser —
pourtant, je désire toujours déchirer
le rideau dont m’entourent tes paroles pleines de grâce,
je désire toujours contempler ton vrai visage.
Au plus profond de la forêt où j’entre dans le secret de ton cœur,
je découvre ta douceur, belle comme une eau claire,
ton cœur qui s’écoule comme un chant.
Dans le dialogue de tes paroles chaleureuses,
dans l’affrontement ardent avec toi,
naît pourtant en moi, du plus profond de mon cœur,
un courant d’amour pour toi.
text.bo:
གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བའི་པར་འགའ་ཞིག་མཐོང་རྗེས། བོད་ཀྱི་རི་བོ་རིམ་པའི་ཁྲོད་དུ་སྦས་པའི་རི་བོ་མཛེས་པོ་འདི་ལ་ང་རང་ཧ་ཅང་དགའ།

ཀྱེ། གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བའི་རི་བོ།
ཁྱེད་ནི་ངའི་སེམས་ཁོང་གི་གཞོན་ནུ་ཕོ་མོ་ཡིན།
ངའི་སེམས་ཀྱི་སྤོས་དྲི་འཐུལ་བའི་རེ་སྨོན་ཡིན།
ཡང་ན་ངའི་ལང་ཚོའི་དུས་ཀྱི་རྒྱུན་མཐུད་ཡིན་ནམ།
མཛེས་པ་དེ་ནི་ལང་ཚོའི་པར་ཞིག་མཐོང་བ་དང་འདྲ།
དེ་ནི་གཞོན་དུས་ཀྱི་ཚོར་བ་རྗེན་པ་དེ་ཡིན།
དེ་དག་ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་ལང་ཚོ་ལྟ་བུའི་ལྗོན་ཤིང 🌳 དང་མཚོ་མ་ཡིན་ནམ།
རེ་སྨོན་བཅངས་པའི་ངས་ཁྱེད་ལ་བརྩེ་བའི་སེམས 💕 འདི་སྲུང་འདོད།
ཁྱེད་ལ་བཅངས་པའི་ངའི་བརྩེ་བའི་འོད་ཟེར་གྱིས།
ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་ལང་ཚོའི་ཞལ་རས་རྟག་ཏུ་དྭངས་མཛེས་སུ་བྱེད།

ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་འཇམ་མཉེན་གྱི་སྤྲིན་པའི་གདོང་ཁེབས།
ཁྱེད་ཀྱིས་ང་ལ་གུས་པའི་སྐད་ཆ་ཞིག་ཤོད་པ་འདྲ།
འོན་ཀྱང་ངས་རྟག་ཏུ་བཤུ་འདོད་པ་ནི།
ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་མཛེས་ཉམས་ལྡན་པའི་གསུང་གིས་བསྐོར་བའི་ཡོལ་བ་དེ།
ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་ཞལ་རས་ངོ་མ་མཐོང་འདོད།
ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་སེམས་གཏིང་གི་ནགས་ཚལ་ཟབ་སར་བསྐྱོད་སྐབས།
ཆུ་དྭངས་མོ་ལྟ་བུའི་ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་འཇམ་མཛེས་ངས་ཤེས་བྱུང་།
གླུ་དབྱངས་ལྟར་རྒྱུ་བའི་ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་སེམས།
ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་དྲོད་འཇམ་གྱི་གསུང་དང་གླེང་མོལ་བྱེད་སྐབས།
ཁྱེད་དང་ཛ་དྲག་པོར་འཐབ་རྩོད་བྱེད་སྐབས།
ངའི་སེམས་ཀྱི་གཏིང་ནས།
ཁྱེད་ལ་བཅངས་པའི་བརྩེ་བ་ཞིག་རྒྱུན་དུ་བཞུར།

在花园里，水仙，迎春，春兰，杜鹃花、牡丹，月季，她们同时在春天盛开。和风吹在我的花园内，吹動着花的香气。

南迦巴瓦，愿你保留你的容颜
看过南迦巴瓦山的一些照片，很喜欢西藏这个藏在漫漫群山中的秀丽山峰。
南迦巴瓦山啊，
你是我的心里的少男少女，
是我自己心里的透出熏香味的向往，

有愿望的我想保持一颗爱你的心💕，
因为我的爱你的光芒，
将使你的情青的面容总是清秀。
你轻柔的云的面纱，
你貌似的对我发出尊重的话语，
可是我却总是希望撕下，
你的优雅的话语所包围的遮幕，
总是想看到你的真容，

流出的一种爱意。

summary.en: English new continues Middle English newe/new/nywe and Old English nīowe/nīewe/nēowe. Merriam-Webster traces these through Germanic *neuja- to Indo-European *neu̯i̯o-, derived from *neu̯o-. French nouveau continues Latin novellus, a derivative of novus. The Latin base and English word belong to an independently documented Indo-European family; neither is derived from Chinese 牛.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 new 承接中古英语 newe／new／nywe 和古英语 nīowe／nīewe／nēowe；Merriam-Webster 上溯至日耳曼语拟构 *neuja- 及印欧语拟构 *neu̯i̯o-、*neu̯o-。法语 nouveau 来自拉丁语 novellus，后者由 novus 派生。拉丁语基础词与英语词的印欧词族关系有独立辞书依据；二者均不据此与牛建立历史关系。

claim.en: English new has an independent Germanic / Indo-European history.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 new 有独立的日耳曼语／印欧语历史。

claim.en: French nouveau derives from Latin novellus, from novus; a Latin derivative, not a borrowing from English new.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 nouveau 源于拉丁语 novellus，后者由 novus 派生；不是借自英语 new。

summary.en: Surface similarity: moderate for UK /njuː/, limited-to-moderate for US /nuː/; qualitative editorial assessment, not a measured distance. Both share /n/. UK /j/ resembles the Mandarin medial; US lacks it. English /uː/ differs from the Mandarin iou rime and its vowel movement. Mandarin rising lexical tone has no lexical-tone counterpart in English.
summary.zh-Hans: 表面音近：UK /njuː/ 评为中等，US /nuː/ 评为有限至中等；这是定性编辑评估，不是测量分数。共同点是 /n/；英式 /j/ 与普通话介音近似，美式参考读音没有该音。英语 /uː/ 与普通话 iou 韵母及其元音运动不同；普通话阳平也没有英语词汇声调对应。

claim.en: Documented context: 子–鼠 and 丑–牛; conventionally 子 23:00–01:00 and 丑 01:00–03:00. A mediated Bintuilu passage distinguishes the earlier and later parts of 子 across days and disputes treating the start of 子 as an automatic date change. This is evidence of a historical discussion, not a universal chronology.
claim.zh-Hans: 已核验的文化背景：子—鼠、丑—牛；通行换算子时 23:00–01:00、丑时 01:00–03:00。《宾退录》平台转录区分子时前后部分的日期归属，并辨析是否一入子时就换日；这说明存在历史辨析，不能据此宣布历代统一制度。

supporting_cases: One authored pair: new → 牛; documented cultural context only
counterexamples: 牛 has no supported standard NEW sense in the consulted lexical entry; print normative entry verification remains pending.
Independent English etymology; modern resemblance may be accidental.
Yod-dropping / accent selection changes the comparison.
Mandarin iou rime and rising tone are unmatched; spelling is not sound.
The zodiac-to-renewal bridge is authored; cultural facts do not prove cognacy.
Selecting one attractive pair invites selection bias; English new and French nouveau are not independent etymological replications.

testability.en: Pre-register auditory judgments for both English accents and Mandarin; compare matched random pairs, new→新 semantic control, culture-informed versus uninformed listeners, and culturally unrelated sound matches. Test memory benefit separately from sound distance. Deduplicate etymological families; no single-case generalization.
testability.zh-Hans: 预注册两种英语参考口音与普通话的听辨；设置匹配随机词对、new→新语义对照、知晓／不知晓文化背景的听者，以及无文化联系的音近对照。记忆收益与音系距离分别测试，词源家族去重；不从单例归纳规律。

proposition.en: Build bridges between languages, toward an age of spaceflight.
proposition.zh-Hans: 架起语言之间的桥梁，面向未来的宇航时代。

text.en: Build bridges between languages, toward a future age of spaceflight. When English or French reaches the ear, I imagine Collanguage turning the phrase into Chinese music, its notes rising and falling. Language Book explores this hope through language and culture. In my vineyard, manna flowers bloom.
text.zh-Hans: 架起语言之间的桥梁，让我们面向未来的宇航时代。当英语或法语传来，我想象借助 Collanguage 的规则与想象，把语句转成高低错落、如音乐般的汉语，走向美好的交流。考虑文化的因素，以汉语拼音探索跨语系的语言，是 Language Book 的追寻。在我的葡萄园，玛娜花盛开。

evidence_boundary.en: A literary aspiration, not a claim that automatic translation or a language law has been validated. The speculative names in the original note are not evidence for etymology or historical relation.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 文学愿景不意味着自动翻译能力或语言规律已获验证；原始笔记的推想不构成词源或历史关系证据。

summary.en: Sign belongs to the Latin signum/signare ‘mark, token’ family. Cognitive/cognition belongs to Latin cognoscere/cognitio ‘know, knowledge’, with the gnosc-/gno- KNOW family. These are separate historical clusters.
summary.zh-Hans: sign 属拉丁语 signum／signare“标记、符号”词族；cognitive／cognition 属拉丁语 cognoscere／cognitio“认识、知识”及 gnosc-／gno- KNOW 词族。两者是不同的历史簇。

claim.en: Sign belongs to the Latin signum/signare ‘mark, token’ family. Cognitive/cognition belongs to Latin cognoscere/cognitio ‘know, knowledge’, with the gnosc-/gno- KNOW family. These are separate historical clusters.
claim.zh-Hans: sign 属拉丁语 signum／signare“标记、符号”词族；cognitive／cognition 属拉丁语 cognoscere／cognitio“认识、知识”及 gnosc-／gno- KNOW 词族。两者是不同的历史簇。

claim.en: signum and cognoscere are not merged into one root; ign/ogn are treated as an authorial consonantal-skeleton hypothesis only.
claim.zh-Hans: 不把 signum 与 cognoscere 合并成一个词根；ign／ogn 只作为作者辅音骨架假说保留。

summary.en: The written sequences ign/ogn/gn are not interchangeable morphemes. In sign the g is silent in the modern base form, while cognitive has /gn/ distributed by its Latin morphology and modern pronunciation.
summary.zh-Hans: 书写序列 ign／ogn／gn 不是可互换语素；现代 sign 的 g 不发音，而 cognitive 中相关字母受拉丁形态和现代读音制约。
